name: Anby
description:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

profile.impression_f:
Anby often comes to the video store to borrow movies and returns them quickly, so she seems to watch a lot of movies.
Feelin' the pressure, bro? As the manager of the video rental store, it'd be embarrassing if the amount of movies we watch falls behind our customers.
profile.impression_m: Honestly, I'm most curious about Anby's playlist. She's got her headphones on constantly... but what exactly is she listening to?

1.name: Rapid Charge Mode
1.desc: When the 4th hit of Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.
1.desc2:
"Charge up for just a minute, and you're set to fight for an hour!" That's the sales pitch for these weapon expansion modules.
And they deliver exactly that.

2.name: Precision Discharge
2.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Thunderbolt</color> hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.
2.desc2:
"Electric shocks will knock you out cold."
Looking at the enemy out cold at her feet, she added:
"At least, that's what happens in the movies."

3.name: Well-Disciplined
3.desc2: Run, slash, move like lightning. She is no amateur when it comes to Hollows—she's an expert.

4.name: Conducting Charge
4.desc:
When Anby launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy.
For every 12% Energy Generation Rate Anby has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.
4.desc2: You won't last long fighting solo. An experienced Hollow Raider knows how to create opportunities for their teammates.

5.name: Street Experience
5.desc2: Working for the Cunning Hares not only builds your mental toughness but also helps (or rather, forces) you to get in shape.

6.name: Charging Field
6.desc: When Anby uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
6.desc2:
Coils of electricity flickered over her fingertips.
Anby raised her head, eyes brimming with determination beyond her years.
Perhaps, one day, she will be the one with total mastery over electricity.

strategy: Consistently Stuns enemies and accumulates Daze

name: Nekomata
description:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.

profile.impression_f:
Kitty cat! Who doesn't like kitty cats!
Ohhh, I want to touch Nekomata's tails! She's got two, that's double the fun!
profile.impression_m:
Take it easy... She's not some harmless little kitten on the street in New Eridu...
When dealing with Nekomata, the most important thing is keeping an eye on your wallet...

1.name: Bird Hunter
1.desc: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
1.desc2: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

2.name: Cat & Mouse
2.desc: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
2.desc2:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

3.name: Curious Left Tail
3.desc2:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

4.name: Sharpen Claws
4.desc: When Nekomata uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
4.desc2:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

5.name: Lucky Right Tail
5.desc2: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

6.name: Predator Lineage
6.desc: When Nekomata launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
6.desc2:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

strategy: Boosts DMG dealt with Dodge Counter

name: Nicole
description:
Database search: Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.

profile.impression_f: Turns out Nicole is more famous in the biz than I thought huh!
profile.impression_m: Instead of these astute comments, I'm more interested in seeing a comprehensive list of everything Nicole owes us.

3110310.name: Nicole: Lil Sassy
3110310.desc: The classic outfit of the leader of the Cunning Hares, hiding a hint of playful cunning, both mischievous and cute.

3110311.name: Nicole: Cunning Cutie
3110311.desc: Pink! Pink! Pink! Pink is Nicole's signature color. So are you feeling it?

descriptions.desc:

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Do As I Please
descriptions.desc: After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Nicole can reload, and her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> are enhanced, increasing the power of her bullets.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Do As I Please
Dodge: Speed Demon
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to dodge, then hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to reload while dodging, enhancing <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Jack in the Box
descriptions.desc:
When dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>:
Dashes in the target direction and strikes nearby enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When not dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>:
Vaults backward and launches a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Diverted Bombard
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.desc:

Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Ether Grenade
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When using this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Emergency Bombard
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> up to 8 times.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: The Hare Strikes Back!

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trust_lv.3:
Master, based on your firsthand account and Agent Anby's testimony, Soldier 11's real name is Harin. She's one of the clones from New Eridu's former clone soldier project and, like Anby, once served in the Defense Force's Silver Squad.

This research project produced multiple clones programmed to obey the upper ranks of the Defense Force without question. However, due to various complications, it was scrapped years ago. The Defense Force sought to erase the unethical experiment and its results, preserving only one soldier as a symbolic success. Anby had been the intended candidate, but her self-destructive act to protect Soldier 11 led to Soldier 11 being the one preserved. Magus, captain of Obol Squad, later chose to bring Soldier 11 into her squad.

Having never known the truth, Soldier 11 grew up resenting Anby, feeling abandoned and betrayed. She set her sights on becoming stronger than Anby — stronger than anyone. Still, she developed a strong rapport with her squadmates in Obol Squad, and now considers them her most important allies.

name: Yidhari
description:
In addition to her role as an Agent, Yidhari doubles as both a Proxy, and a contributor for Spook Shack.
To most, she comes across as laid-back and leisurely, but according to records, it's less "laziness" than a shroud of nothingness, leaving her at odds with the world around her.
Perhaps to most people, this would seem like the usual quirk of someone absorbed in their craft. As a gifted writer of bizarre tales, Yidhari should be more prone than most to immersing herself in the worlds of her own imagination.
In truth, however, her unusual behavior stems more from the burden of her own abilities.
In the Hollows, she's exposed to vast torrents of information unimaginable to most, tangled with years upon years of memories that have amassed there. That crushing weight of countless pasts constantly batters her sense of reality, until even her emotions are gradually worn dull.
The fact that she can bear this burden, turn it into her own strength, and still live life in her own way — that's what sets Yidhari apart as gifted beyond others.

profile.impression_f:
Yidhari always seems like she couldn't care less, but she's actually really thoughtful and knows how to take care of others!
Once, while I was carrying some videotapes, I got a small cut on my hand without even noticing, and she came right over with a bandage and put it on for me!
profile.impression_m: I know the feeling... When we hung out together before, I was in such a rush, I skipped lunch, and she noticed right away. She said my lips looked pale, so I must have come without eating, even though I couldn't tell myself...

trust_lv.3:
Yidhari has an unusual fondness for rainy days and long baths.
These two comforts grant her brief moments of peace in the real world, allowing her moments of rest free from the tangled streams of information in her mind.

But lately, her feelings toward these two comforts have changed.
She's grown unaccustomed to being alone, no longer anxiously yearning for the rain, no longer relying on warm baths to heal herself.
She has begun strolling beneath clear skies, moving with ease through bustling crowds... and looking forward to trying everything that feels new to her.
For Yidhari, everything started to change from the moment she met you.

3110510.desc: Past recollections and novel dreams spill over, inviting her to drown in them as they entwine on paper. With a blank page before her, she pens the opening line at the crossroads of reality and illusion.

name: Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection
Additional Ability: Narrative Completion
desc:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When Yidhari's HP falls below 50%, CRIT DMG increases by 30% and DMG taken is reduced by 25%.
While Yidhari is within <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, she gains the following additional effect:
After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
The above skill is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the DMG multiplier increases based on the EX Special Attack's level.

1.name: The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
1.desc: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced by 10. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frost Coil</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>. The HP restored by this <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> ignore 20% of targets' <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color>.
1.desc2:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

2.name: Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought?
2.desc: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Surging Cold</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Crushing Pursuit</color> grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
2.desc2:
In the darkness lay the girl's slumbering thoughts.
They were not innocent daydreams, nor carefree flights of fancy.
Her mind was fixed on the memories she had witnessed.
"What must I do? What must I bear?"
"Good thing it's me, and not someone else."
"I know how to deal with being alone... I think."
As she sifted through those pasts, the girl calmly accepted this heavy gift.

3.name: A Story Without an Audience
3.desc2:
So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.

4.name: Blooming in Silence
4.desc: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.
4.desc2:
The flower trembled as it bloomed in the dark, white and translucent, as though it reflected the lone light of the abyss's depths.
—It was, in truth, a soul, fragile yet unyielding.
Amid the countless falling shadows, amid the flood of cascading memories... she remained untouched, still blooming with her own strength.
But in the end... will she too fade away, drifting with nothing to hold on to?

5.name: This Solace Is Real
5.desc2:
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."

6.name: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
6.desc: After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, she gains <color=#FFFFFF>Erudition</color> for 30s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Erudition</color> is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.
6.desc2:
Immersed in the tide of memories, she had never found even fleeting rest.
Her only refuge was solitude, escaping the bustle of the world, losing herself in strange tales, seeking quiet beneath veils of misty rain or within the embrace of warm waters.
But now, she can walk calmly among the crowds, no longer troubled by noise or the burning sun, for "illusion" no longer binds her spirit, and "reality" has become the anchor of her soul.

name: Corin
description:
Corin is one of the maids working for Victoria Housekeeping Co.
She is a highly obedient maid but lacks confidence and often fears being disliked by others. When in a rush, she becomes flustered and stutters.
Corin is always apologizing no matter what happens.
"I... I... I'm so sorry! I'm so incompetent... I'll never get things right..."

Corin never, however, fails to fulfill her tasks with excellence and is one of the most reliable members of Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Despite her flawless performance, Corin remains skeptical about her abilities, constantly worrying about being a burden to her colleagues, which can sometimes frustrate Lycaon.
Thoughts: Is Corin's personality innate, shaped by her life experiences?

profile.impression_f:
Corin is excellent at her work, but why does she lack confidence in herself...?
If only I could share half of my confidence with her!
profile.impression_m:
Some people are just introverted and sensitive. Fortunately, Corin's companions have complete faith in her capabilities.
Belle, let's encourage her whenever we have the opportunity.

1.name: Open Trauma
1.desc: When Corin's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.
1.desc2:
"The young mistress always said, if something's worth doing, it's worth focusing on."
"I've been practicing, and I can do it now!"
"But... are you watching me...?"

2.name: Atomic Smash
2.desc: When Corin's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color> is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
2.desc2:
"Sorry, Mr. or Ms. Ethereal!"
"But I've got work to do... I really am sorry!"
Feeling guilty, Corin sincerely apologizes to the monster — as she wields her savage chainsaw, slicing through the enemies in her way.

3.name: Amateur Maid
3.desc2: "I—I'll do my best to become a good maid!" Corin said, walking towards the Ethereals, chainsaw in hand.

4.name: Battlefield Retainer
4.desc: When Corin uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
4.desc2:
A diligent and serious young maid, Corin always puts her heart and soul into everything she does.
Of course, that includes taking out enemies in combat.

5.name: Special Ops Maid
5.desc2:
"Uh... sorry, I'm so clumsy. I don't know how to make sure my cuts are even..."
—Said Corin as she looked down at the bits of Ethereal scattered across the ground.

6.name: Accumulated Release
6.desc:
When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
6.desc2:
Corin knows that she isn't the most powerful of maids, nor the smartest. But she hopes to become the hardest working.
She puts to good use everything she's ever learned.

strategy: Increases DMG dealt when hitting Stunned enemies

name: Caesar
description:
Caesar: Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang and a "monarch" in the making.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears — regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.
(Assumption: Caesar currently views you in this way.)

Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember, and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.

In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.
If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.

profile.impression_f:
Big Daddy looks cultured and sophisticated, but Caesar's a different kettle of fish...
But even though she often gets her idioms wrong, Caesar's still very cute!
profile.impression_m:
Earning the trust of the Outer Ring's Overlord is a pretty big deal. We should really appreciate that.
Of course, it'd be nice if Caesar could make fewer typos in her DMs to us.

Caesar has a fear of needles.
"They're so tiny and thin, and it only stings for a second when you're pricked — but then all this blood comes out. It's so weird — and definitely not straightforward at all!"

3110710.name: Caesar: Inferno Joyride
3110710.desc:
A ruler ready to ready to sound the triumphal anthem anew, a hero poised to reignite her legend. The not-yet-seasoned leader has finally met the flames of her coronation, yet she still walks the gritty sands of the Outer Ring.
A light tap on the piano keys sends her desert-tinged song drifting across this land that bears the weight of hope.

Following that, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>.

Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color>.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
When <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

descriptions.desc:

If <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill when <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is triggered.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Parry Counter
descriptions.desc:

Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
descriptions.desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Parry Counter</color>, with enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:

If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.

1.name: Spearhead Advance
1.desc: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.
1.desc2:
"Big Daddy taught me that this is when you form a spearheaded formation with overwhelming force and strike at the enemy's weakest point—"
"And I'll be leading the charge, of course!"

2.name: Legacy of the Far Lands
2.desc: While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience</color> is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.
2.desc2:
Caesar's combat style stands out from those of New Eridu or the Outer Ring, drawing from the techniques of the most skilled warriors among the wanderers.
Knowing when to hold back and when to strike decisively — that has always been the wanderer's way of survival. And Caesar has always been a good student of this philosophy.

3.name: Absolute Trust
3.desc2:
Once Caesar recognizes someone as one of her own, she fully accepts them as part of her inner circle. She gives them absolute trust, letting her guard down completely...
Just like she does with you now.

4.name: Aries the Battering-Ram
4.desc: When Caesar uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 3 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color>. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.
4.desc2:
One of the tactics Caesar mastered under the guidance of the wanderers.
"No matter what, I'll fight till the last moment!"

5.name: Romantic Conquest
5.desc2:
Behind Caesar's carefree and unpolished appearance lies a romantic at heart.
She's always curious about love stories.
But if you dig a little deeper into the subject... you might just catch her blushing.

6.name: Overlord's Will
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade</color> are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target. When Caesar uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade</color>, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.
6.desc2:
"I used to keep my eyes straight ahead, thinking that as long as I was strong enough, I could do anything."
"But being a great leader takes more than just power."
"I need to protect my friends behind me — they are the reason I can keep going."

strategy: Grants shields and Anti-Interrupt to all squad members
Provides attack boosts to on-field squadmates

name: Billy
description:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

profile.impression_f:
Weren't you obsessed with the Starlight Knight series as a kid, Wise?
That brings me back. You shouting "Starlight Mirage!" with your arms crossed...
profile.impression_m:
There was never such a time. Please erase such non-existent memories from your mind.
It's been a long time since I was that age, after all, and my name doesn't have "kid" in it.

3110810.name: Billy: Shining Starlight Costume
3110810.desc: Style is justice, justice is style. That's the eternal creed of a true knight! Though, yeah... those joint screws really do wear down fast...

descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes a piercing attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the attack duration.
Drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

When not dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Dazzling Entrance
1.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.
1.desc2:
"You guys are way too honest to be bad guys!"
"All lined up, like NPCs at the shooting range!"

2.name: Roaming Gunslinger
2.desc: Billy's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodges</color>. When a Rolling Shot triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will automatically follow up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>.
2.desc2:
"The Starlight Knights never run from danger. That's what we call tactical repositioning for better aim!"
— User "Dreamgirl Monica" from the Starlight Radiance messageboards.

3.name: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
3.desc2: Never neglect your training, and never stop improving! This is the philosophy of the Starlight Knights. Billy believes in it wholeheartedly, and practices it sincerely.

4.name: Starlight Ballistics
4.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the skill's CRIT Rate increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.
4.desc2:
These explosive bullets of Billy's own invention are incredibly lethal at close range.
Their performance far outstrips Billy's original intention of simply making them cooler.

5.name: Lost Technological Construct
5.desc2: Unknown precision components and unique structural design have given Billy performance far beyond his peers... And maintenance costs far beyond his means.

6.name: Starlight Hero
6.desc: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
6.desc2:
"Hooboy~ Feelin' great! Move aside, Anby, it's my time to shine!"
"Yo, Anby — can you play the Starlight Knight theme?"
—excerpt from Cunning Hares' "Top 10 Forbidden Sentences," selected by Anby

specialElement.name: Frost
specialElement.title: Frost
specialElement.desc:
The <color=#98EFF0>Frost Attribute</color> calculates damage and buff effects based on the <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color> attribute. When dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, it accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> on enemies, which triggers the <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> effect and applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> status.
The <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> effect renders the target unable to act for a duration.
The <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> effect activates when the <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> effect ends, interrupting the enemy's actions and inflicting <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
The <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect increases the CRIT DMG received by the target for a limited time.

description:
Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

profile.impression_f: Fairy! Find that "precious visual recording"! My brother wants to see it!
profile.impression_m: There's no need to trouble yourself, Fairy. If Belle wants to see it, she'll ask Miss Miyabi herself...

According to an insider, Miyabi's mother died when she was young and Miyabi's relationship with her father is rather odd.
Note: Miyabi's father has not taken any civil or administrative positions within New Eridu.

3110910.name: Hoshimi Miyabi: Frostgleam Dew
3110910.desc: A blade that fells the Hollows, a lighthouse that pierces the fog. People hope for a fighter who hones the world and a helmsman who steers the course; for flags that never fall and honor that lives on. Yet power is finite. Only training remains constant.

3110911.name: Hoshimi Miyabi: Dignified Blossom
3110911.desc:
As blooms first grace the banquet hall and frost dusts the silver courtyard, the young lady would retreat to a quiet corner whenever guests gathered — eyes downcast, book in hand, softly reciting verses from days long past.
Guests would shower them with praise: the Hoshimi Family still upheld tradition, dignified and cultured as ever.
Only Souichirou stood nearby, his eye twitching slightly — he knew better than anyone that his daughter probably didn't grasp half the poem's true meaning.

When releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or when <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>. She then exits <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.

desc:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, she applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>750%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>14%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

1.name: Frost Atop the Snow
1.desc: While in <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>, every 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> consumed will allow <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> ends. When the slash for charge level three of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>, it will immediately remove the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
1.desc2:
Miyabi has loved reciting poems about the cold since she was a child. She might not understand them completely, but she still does it every day.
Before long, she came to realize their true meaning.
She found clarity not on a still and snowy night, but rather upon the battlefield.

2.name: Breath Technique
2.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> when the final move of the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
2.desc2:
"As goes the sword, so goes the heart." This is a key disciplinary concept of the Hoshimi school of swordsmanship.
Defeating the enemy is but the first step on the path to victory. 
Maintaining constant vigilance at all times is the true way of a warrior.

3.name: Martial Discipline
3.desc2: Miyabi, whose family has a tradition of martial arts, has excellent training habits. Her commitment to swordsmanship practice is unwavering. What? A meeting? She won't be going.

4.name: Rupture
4.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color> DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.
4.desc2:
Reciting poems during the heat of battle can regulate one's respiratory rhythm.
Whether it's her mindset or breathing, Miyabi always keeps calm.

5.name: Anniversary
5.desc2:
The girl arrives at that all too familiar place with flowers, her breath misting and then vanishing into the cold air.
Her fingers ghost over that name on the monument.
Everything is quiet, like that most silence observer.

6.name: Prodigious Talent
6.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains <color=#FFFFFF>Polar</color>, which increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> DMG by 30%. After obtaining <color=#FFFFFF>Polar</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. Before <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>. Each occurrence of <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.
6.desc2: The more she battles, the more it becomes evident to outsiders: If there is a god of swordsmanship, it must greatly favor Hoshimi Miyabi.

strategy: Consumes Fallen Frost to unleash charged slashes
Can trigger Disorder with all Attribute Anomaly effects
Can convert CRIT Rate into Anomaly Buildup Rate

name: Koleda
description:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. 
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows. 
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

profile.impression_f:
What's that line from that detective movie we watched again?
"She may look like a child..." Well, no matter how old she is or how she looks, Koleda really is a kid, and she's so cute!
profile.impression_m: I hope your comment isn't seen by a certain someone, or our video store will be end up smashed to bits by a hammer.

3111010.name: Koleda: Heart & Hammer
3111010.desc:
A crimson figure swings twin hammers as if she could even shatter time itself.
Still young, her journey is only just beginning. Growing up can wait; in the end, every person becomes their own true self.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Smash 'n' Bash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Koleda has the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect, she can launch an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> after the 2nd hit, consuming the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect and dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When Koleda and Ben are deployed together, executing an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> will trigger a coordinated attack from both, further increasing the move's power;
Koleda is invulnerable during the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 4th hit and enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Wait 'n' See
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Tremble!
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
Special Attack: Hammer Time
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
This skill launches faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Boiling Furnace
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Koleda also gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect.
This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Natural Disaster
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> while also obtaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Hammerquake
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> while also obtaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Coming Thru!
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Protective Hammer
descriptions.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Hammer Bell
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Koleda charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and obtaining <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Beat of the Hammer
1.desc: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or her enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, quickly use a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
1.desc2: Her fiery temper is just a facade. In reality, Koleda's thoughts are quite intricate. For example, she knows when to swing her hammer for a more painful strike.

2.name: Kinetic Recovery
2.desc: When Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
2.desc2:
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.

3.name: "Mind Your Own!"
3.desc2:
As a qualified "toy," you better not cause trouble when Koleda starts to get a feel for swinging her hammer. Just take the beating.
—After all, what's the point of resisting?

4.name: Furnace's Glow
4.desc: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> to use her Enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When her <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Natural Disaster</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Hammerquake</color> hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
4.desc2:
Koleda feels the flames of war as her hammer swings raise the surrounding temperature.
She's now even more flammable and explosive than Ether.

5.name: "You Dare Underestimate Me?"
5.desc2: Koleda cares deeply about her role as a young leader potentially causing others to underestimate Belobog Heavy Industries. To compensate, she consistently trains diligently in secret.

6.name: Saturated Blast
6.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
6.desc2:
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.

name: Anton
description:
Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
 Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?" 
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"
Unfortunately, I have not collected enough information on such occurrences and am not able to deliver further analysis.

profile.impression_f:
Anton keeps saying he's the "second-best driller in the company."
So... who's the first?
profile.impression_m: I think it's the heavy drill machine from their company. I've heard him say something like "I gotta win next time" against it.

trust_lv.3:
Here is a video recording depicting Anton's life:
Late at night at the construction site, Anton gazes down at his jackhammer and mutters to himself, "Dang, this is exhausting, Bro..."
As the jackhammer buzzed to life, Anton nodded in acknowledgment. "No, a real one doesn't complain about being tired! Thanks for reminding me, buddy! You can never back down from a challenge!"
The truth is, Anton had set up demanding tasks for the construction workers, hoping to push them to their limits and unlock their true potential. However, witnessing their struggles and diminishing confidence, he couldn't bear to see them suffer any longer, so he secretly completed all the tasks in the dead of night.
In the end, Anton became the one who accepted all the trials.

* Anton's beloved "bro," aka his jackhammer, appears to have a connection to his former colleagues.

1.name: Warm-Up Exercises
1.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color> hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
1.desc2:
"Are you awake? Get spinning, bro!"
"Try and keep up. It's time to do our stretches!"

2.name: State of Flow
2.desc: When Anton uses his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Burst Mode</color>, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his Max HP. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Burst Mode</color>, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when <color=#FFFFFF>Burst Mode</color> ends.
2.desc2:
After arduous training, a few lucky individuals will display exceptional vigor and perform above their usual level during high-intensity activities, entering a state of flow commonly known as "being in the zone."
Are you ready to get moving and enter the zone?
— Nitro-Fuel's exclusive program "Good Morning, Zealous Office Workers!"

3.name: Rotational Training
3.desc2: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but in a complex and ever-changing Hollow worksite, having a wide skillset can present an opportunity to overcome difficulties.

4.name: Everyone Get Fired Up!
4.desc: When Anton uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 12s.
4.desc2:
"Find your rhythm, and let's get moving!"
When Anton starts to get serious, everyone becomes more nimble.
They have to keep up or else they will be training alone the next day.

5.name: Jack of All Trades
5.desc2: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!

6.name: Break the Limit
6.desc: When Anton's <color=#FFFFFF>Piledriver Attack</color> triggers a critical hit, his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode)</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Overload Drill (Burst Mode)</color> deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
6.desc2:
"Yeah bro, can you feel the burn?"
Whenever Anton wants to exceed his limits,
his "bro" starts spinning at an astonishing pace, its buzzing echoing Anton's resolution.

name: Ben
description:
Ben is the financial and asset management director at Belobog Heavy Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"I enjoy mathematics, but that doesn't stop me from giving thugs a good smack."
He's a burly and strong Thiren. Despite his tough exterior, he's of a surprisingly sensitive and detail-oriented nature, especially when it comes to numbers.
Originally a frontline mechanical operator at Belobog, his talents caught Koleda's discerning eye, leading to his promotion to a managerial position responsible for the company's finances.
Grateful for Koleda's trust in him, he remains profoundly loyal to her.
His favorite food is black caviar, but he dislikes fish.

I once witnessed this imposing figure seated in a small office chair, wearing small glasses, and carefully cross-referencing Belobog's asset records while mashing away at a calculator with his huge fingers.
Question: Is that what they call on Inter-Knot a "Kawaii Curveball?"

profile.impression_f:
The first time I saw him, I was definitely taken aback...
Who would've thought Ben was unexpectedly a soft, furry, gentle-natured bear!
profile.impression_m:
Never judge a book by its cover.
That said, it seems he's often required to present a menacing image to deter the enemy... and it appears to be quite effective.

After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value.
After activating the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

name: Soukaku
description:
Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.

profile.impression_f: So many "avoid doing this" and "don't do thats"... It makes it look like Soukaku's difficult to get along with, but she's a super cute and sweet kid!
profile.impression_m: That's probably because we've always avoided the things Fairy warns us about... At least, I won't be taking the risk and trying anything.

1.desc2:

2.name: Experimental Charging Module
2.desc:
When Soukaku's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, triggering up to once per second.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.
2.desc2:
A charging module is able to continuously accumulate energy during battle.
Therefore, it is regarded as an era-defining conceptual tactical weapon by the R&D department.
But for Soukaku, fully charging it simply means it's time to eat.

3.name: Attendance Meal Allowance
3.desc2: The best way to motivate Soukaku to train harder is simple: just increase her attendance meal allowance.

4.desc2: The custom-made weapon Oni Banner features a powerful built-in cooling system. Its Ether-infused catalyst generates cold air, dealing significant DMG to enemies it hits.

5.name: Late-Night Snacks

6.name: Northern Wind

6.desc2: Unlocking the safety device within the blade banner allows it to operate at full capacity. It's not just for combat... it's also handy for cooling down a meal.

name: Lycaon
description:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.

profile.impression_f:
Is there truly anything in this world that poses a challenge for Lycaon?
It seems that no matter what obstacles he encounters, he effortlessly solves them all (as long as you touch his tail)!
profile.impression_m:
Belle, did your comment get mixed up with your personal preferences...?
And Fairy suggested touching Lycaon's chin and head, not his tail.
profile.profile_desc:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.
unlock_condition: Complete Agent Story "And the True Heroes Are Always Behind the Scenes"

trust_lv.3:
Lycaon has a troubled past that he keeps to himself.
Despite his current elegant and gentle demeanor, the former Lycaon led a wild lifestyle and had a friend whom he trusted implicitly.
However, this friend has now become a bitter enemy.

Note: Due to limited information, it is challenging to uncover the specifics of his past.
You should consider trying to gather information from different angles about the individuals involved to obtain more valuable intelligence.

3111410.name: Lycaon: Moonlight Prowl
3111410.desc: Under the clear moonlight, the attendant's poise is flawless. Yet with the red moon's ascent, the feral nature hidden beneath this suit emerges with a composure and grace all its own.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Moon Hunter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold down <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge up, increasing the power of the attack and dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Suitable Positioning
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Keep it Clean
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slides forward, launching a series of strikes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Etiquette Manual
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Time to Hunt
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hold down <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hold down <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
Chain Attack: As You Wish
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Mission Complete
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Wolf Pack
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Disrupted Hunt
descriptions.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Disrupted Hunt
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Quickly launch multiple strikes against enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Metallic Paws
Additional Ability: Elegant Predator
desc:
When Lycaon completes charging during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> has available activations, hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Lycaon enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance is gained. Up to 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation can be stored.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends, Lycaon automatically activates <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>6%</color>.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Lycaon will end the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state early.
When Lycaon manually uses <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state also ends early, but <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> will not be automatically triggered.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, Lycaon will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When the active character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. After performing a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> duration does not decrease.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Lycaon hits a Stunned enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%.

1.name: Full Moon Momentum
1.desc: When Lycaon's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.
1.desc2:
Records suggest that werewolves exposed to moonlight become significantly more aggressive.
"Don't stare directly at the moon."

2.name: Energy Feedback
2.desc: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.
2.desc2:
"Canines receive a brief dopamine boost in their brains after completing semi-complex tasks. At that moment, if their owner pets them to show encouragement, they will be extremely happy..."
—Excerpt from the "Handbook of Unreliable Canine Research"

3.name: Attendant Training
3.desc2: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

4.name: Graceful Demeanor
4.desc:
If Lycaon is attacked while using a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.
During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
4.desc2: "An outstanding attendant maintains a graceful demeanor at any and all times."

5.name: Alpha Nature
5.desc2: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.

6.name: Ruthless Hunter
6.desc: When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
6.desc2:
"Apologies, but given the circumstances, I will not show any mercy."
"After all, if a fair fight is what you are after, a Hollow is not the place to look for it."

strategy: Rapidly builds up Daze on enemies

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is currently in charge of outgoing business and managing boars for the Sons of Calydon.
Since her name is far too long and she doesn't want to be involved with her family, she refers to herself as just "Lucy" in the Outer Ring.
Her three boars are called Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and they're unceasingly loyal to her.
Though Lucy often speaks with a mixture of rough and elegant language, her actions subtly betray the marks of a proper education.
Lucy's family is incredibly wealthy. She grew up very privileged, with anything she could ever want within grasp... except for freedom.
After her Ether Aptitude test results came back high, Lucy decided she wanted to be a Hollow investigator, but her family disapproved. She was met with harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.
"Hmph! There's no chance I'll ever go back! If I'm found... then I can say goodbye to the stars and sky and I'll have to inherit the family business instead!"
Lucy is extremely competitive. She loves to win and hates losing.
Currently, the one who has given her the most bitter taste of defeat is Caesar, so Lucy keeps challenging Caesar to duels, losing then challenging again, challenging then losing again.

profile.impression_f: Lucy's Knock Knock profile pic is soooo pretty! Is that what she looked like back when she was still living as a rich heiress?
profile.impression_m: I think Caesar mentioned Lucy only uses this profile picture because it's incredibly effective when it comes to talking business with others...
