trust_lv.3:
Asaba Harumasa has a very rare illness, Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome.
This illness causes certain parts of the patient's body to mutate, wrecking their constitution, but also giving them unusually exceptional Ether aptitude.
In the late stages of the illness, the patient's body will rapidly deteriorate, losing their Ether aptitude and sensory functions while under immense pain, eventually resulting in death. If the patient's illness worsens in late stages while in a Hollow, they'll quickly be corrupted into an Ethereal.
Those who suffer from Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome do not live long. Currently, the longest-lived person with this illness died at the age of 26.
There is no known method to completely cure this disease.

3112010.name: Asaba Harumasa: Full-Fledged Strings
3112010.desc: His eyes are brighter than the streak of bright yellow upon his brow. His arrows pierce through deceit and lies and scatter the past like feathers on the wind. Dawn may not have arrived yet, but beyond the horizon, a golden future shimmers faintly.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color> and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer - Drift
descriptions.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Feather
descriptions.desc:
After the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, or a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Immediately shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to aim at a target and release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya
descriptions.desc:
When the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. If there are no <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present at a time. If there are any <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will activate and fire <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the enemies hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will apply <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, they will be <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Quick Flash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
descriptions.desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
descriptions.desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
Special Attack: Nowhere to Hide
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after using the 4th/5th attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Braced Bow</color> to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field, firing <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the target's <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> stacks are close to the maximum, fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol
Chain Attack: Kai - Hanare
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Zanshin
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Zanshin - Scattered Blossoms
descriptions.desc:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Braced Bow
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Yugamae
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Yugamae - Slash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: "High Spirit"
1.desc: The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.
1.desc2:
"I'm not like some stubborn idiots who insist on facing the enemy head-on."
"Be it a straightforward assault or an underhanded attack from the shadows, anything that gets me off work earlier is good in my eyes~"

2.name: Languish
2.desc: When using an <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color> once <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> ends.
2.desc2:
"Don't look at me like that, I'm actually real frail, y'know~"
Harumasa lazily sprawls across his office desk.
"So... how 'bout picking someone else for this mission?"

3.name: White Lies
3.desc2:
"...Don't worry, this isn't enough to kill me."
He wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth with a smile and readies his bow once more.
"After all, I'm going to live to make it everyone's problem."

4.name: Occasionally Motivated
4.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> now lasts for 20s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, apply the maximum stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> to all on-field enemies.
4.desc2:
Harumasa is occasionally full of energy and motivation...
When there's only five minutes left until he can get off work.

5.name: No One Knows
5.desc2:
"I want vacations, freedom, to be happy every day!"
"Just kidding. I want to live."

6.name: Tacit Understanding
6.desc: After <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color> for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color>, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
6.desc2:
"My master taught me a lot of things, like how to draw a bow, how to wield a blade, and how to survive in this world with this body of mine."
"...What happened after that?"
"Well, after that... he left me."

name: Rina
description:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.

profile.impression_f: Look here, Wise! Can you believe Fairy wants us to try Rina's dishes? She just keeps getting meaner!
profile.impression_m: We don't need to take on such a high level of risk at the moment. I suggest Fairy refrain from making such suggestions next time.

Drusilla, however, may occasionally express her true thoughts regardless of the situation.

* Rina's family holds significant influence within the industry, as all of its members have served as attendants or maids to some of the most prominent figures.
Lycaon learned some of his attendant skills from Rina.

3112110.name: Rina: Head Maid's Perfection
3112110.desc: Her skirt is immaculate and her appearance flawlessly composed — such is the head maid's standard of perfection. Yet in the kitchen, her definition of "perfect" appears to be something else entirely...

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Whack the Dimwit
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo count.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Morning Cleanup
descriptions.desc: After Rina uses her <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate]</color>, within 13s, Drusilla or Anastella attacks enemies once every 2.5s, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> and gaining 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Fright]</color>, up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>[Fright]</color> max. After using this skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit countdown resets.

descriptions.name: Midnight Cleanup
descriptions.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>[Fright]</color> reaches 6, the next time Drusilla or Anastella uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Morning Cleanup]</color>, it will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>[Fright]</color> and trigger <color=#FFFFFF>[Midnight Cleanup]</color> instead; after using this skill, reset Drusilla and Anastella's exit countdown.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Dress Adjustment
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Surprise
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Bangboo Callback
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Beat the Blockhead
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute multiple downward smashes, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>[Quick Assist]</color> is triggered after using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
Chain Attack: Code of Conduct
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>, but can be recalled to Rina's side through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: The Queen's Attendants
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Dash Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Special Attack]</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Shoo, Fool!]</color>.
Upon activating this skill, the other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>[Quick Assist]</color> is triggered.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Duple Meter Allemande
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Evasive Assist: Triple Meter Courante
descriptions.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Quadruple Meter Gavotte

1.name: Dance Duet
1.desc:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner</color> by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
1.desc2:
"Get your work done, or you're in for a beating!" is how Drusilla tries to encourage everyone.
"Yeah, a beating!" Anastella always chimes in.

2.name: Master's Paragon
2.desc: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
2.desc2: "It takes an excellent head maid to lead excellent maids, and an exemplary master to raise exemplary Bangboo." — Excerpt from Rina's speech at the "Victoria Housekeeping Human Resource Management and Bangboo Training Insight Seminar."

3.name: Head Maid's Specialty
3.desc2:
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.

4.name: Needle and Hammer
4.desc: Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed. The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.
4.desc2:
Drusilla and Anastella can never agree on anything.
"Beating up the dummy in front" is an exception.

5.name: Head Maid Perfectionist
5.desc2:
"Rina" means perfection in the Bangboo language.
Perfectionism is the number one rule in the Victoria Housekeeping handbook.
And Rina has her own criteria for judging "perfection."

6.name: Stormy Night's Fright
6.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, the entire squad's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> is increased by 15% for 8s.
6.desc2:
Thunder rumbles in the old castle on a rainy night. The depths of the long corridors are filled with eerie shadows.
Fear circuits overloaded, the filming of a thriller commences.

name: Yanagi
description:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.

profile.impression_f: Where did Fairy even get this info? So even a perfect person like Yanagi has her clumsy moments? Got any specifics to share?
profile.impression_m: How should I put this...? From this data, it feels like Section 6 would fall apart without Yanagi.

3112210.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi: Flowing Moonshade
3112210.desc: Even reflective lenses can't hide the sharp gleam in the Deputy Chief's eyes. She has to constantly keep watch over a warrior obsessed with training, a scout who slacks off whenever possible, and a little one who's forever getting stomachaches.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tsukuyomi Kagura
descriptions.desc:
Yanagi has two stances: <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color>.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Execute up to five forward slashes based on the current stance, causing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During combat, Yanagi gains the corresponding stance buff based on her current stance:
<color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> stance buff: <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by 10%. Anti-Interrupt Level increases during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> stance buff: PEN Ratio increases by 10%. Interrupt Level increases for <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
For 8s after switching stances, Yanagi retains the bonus from the previous stance.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Wandering Breeze
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Fleeting Flight
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Rapid Retaliation
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Ruten
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, and switch the current stance.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, it activates <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance.
Block enemy attacks while <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color> is active.
Upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> from the 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly, it triggers a special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect, <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, dealing 15% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*2.25,100,2}%</color> of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> will not remove the target's Anomaly.

1.name: Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
1.desc: When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color>, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color> to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color>, her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.
1.desc2:
"Having the clarity to see your enemy's weakness is like an extra safety net... and it increases your chances at victory."
Yanagi adjusts her glasses, remaining as composed as ever, even when victory is already assured.

2.name: Outstanding Adaptability
2.desc: During her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the rapid thrust's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
2.desc2:
"Yanagi can handle any unfamiliar environment thrown her way."
"I believe in her more than I believe in myself."
— From a martial artist practicing "the cutting of fallen leaves."

3.name: Tsukishiro Style Management
3.desc2: Everyone says Section 6 is gathering oddballs and geniuses, with Tsukishiro Yanagi being the only "normal" one. But it's precisely her presence that holds the oddballs and geniuses together.

4.name: Chessmaster
4.desc: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the <color=#FFFFFF>Exposed</color> effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Expose</color> effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.
4.desc2: No matter the situation, Tsukishiro Yanagi can rapidly grasp all the information at hand and make the most appropriate decision.

5.name: "Other Mother"
5.desc2:
At present, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the sole designated guardian of Soukaku.
"Soukaku, this is the Chief's riceball, you mustn't eat it... forget it, come here, I'll heat it up for you."
"We'll just buy a similar one for the Chief later."

6.name: Inhuman Blood
6.desc: After a thrust attack during her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state increases to 30s. While the state is active, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Outstanding Adaptability</color> can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.
6.desc2:
Flowing through Tsukishiro Yanagi's veins is blood that isn't entirely her own. This blood once granted her new life in the face of despair, and with it, she gained certain special powers.
"But as you know, something that isn't mine... comes with a price."

name: Zhu Yuan
description:
Zhu Yuan, an exceptional officer at Public Security, is a highly skilled individual expected to become the next commissioner. She currently leads the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team at the Janus Precinct within the Metropolitan Order Division. Her team members include Qingyi, Seth, and [redacted].
Note: For documents with higher security levels within the Public Security system, further investigation is required; scheduling priority - low.

Zhu Yuan possesses excellent skills in criminal investigation, combat, and self-management (including working overtime). She has no unresolved cases on record.

trust_lv.3:
She has a tendency to be a perfectionist and exhibits a strong obsession with "neatness" and "perfection," which may be considered her only weakness (?). Officer Qingyi, her mentor in life and subordinate at work, often remarks that Zhu Yuan's perfectionism complex will worsen unless someone can talk her out of it. However, due to her high standards for herself, she has gained ample experience and skills to lead the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team and attract exceptional talents.

Zhu Yuan seems to have a passion for gardening. She is currently growing a tomato plant in her office, which is often pilfered by a raccoon family residing near the Public Security office.
Thoughts: Could this provide a potential avenue for infiltrating Public Security?

Zhu Yuan is a rarity among humans, showing no particular fondness for small furry animals.

Winner of the Janus Precinct's combat tournament three years running, the young top Public Security Officer is on call 24/7, ready to arrest any criminal in her path.

This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...

3.name: Public Security Special Training
3.desc2: As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal.

4.name: Ether Perforation
4.desc: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>, her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower</color> ignore 25% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether RES</color>.
4.desc2: When in battle, the gangs in the Hollows often try to quietly calculate how many bullets their enemies have left. What they don't know is that Zhu Yuan's custom magazine can recharge itself with the Ether in the air...

5.name: Special Ops Experience
5.desc2: A seasoned Public Security Officer excels at reading the battlefield, striking precisely and maximizing combat efficiency. Sometimes, one stern look is enough to make her enemies think twice about putting up a fight.

6.name: Expanded Energy Pack III
6.desc: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>, she receives the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Afterglow</color> effect, and the Energy cost of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced by 30. Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will consume <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Afterglow</color> and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
6.desc2: Zhu Yuan often worries about her gear's remaining battery, getting nervous when the power dips into the red zone and consciously saving power. Public Security finally equipped her with an energy pack that offered both high capacity and long-lasting endurance.

strategy: Suppressive Mode and Shotshell Rapid Fire

name: Qingyi
description:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.

profile.impression_f: Why does Fairy only warn us once when it comes to Qingyi? She warned us to "remember our true identity" three whole times when she gave suggestions about Zhu Yuan!
profile.impression_m:
Because even if she knew, she'd pretend she didn't...
She might even have already guessed.

3112510.name: Qingyi: Clarity, Peace, and Joy
3112510.desc: Keep your teapot close and drink plenty of hot water — that's ancient wisdom passed down from the old civilization. But why would an intelligent construct drink tea? It must be for health purposes... right?

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Penultimate
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Blossoms
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Flash Connect
descriptions.desc: When Qingyi deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> with a skill, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> reaches 75%, she will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect</color> state. When using her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, Qingyi will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> and exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect</color> state. For every 1% of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color> itself does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms
descriptions.desc:
During the <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Swan Song
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Breach
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Lingering Sentiments
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Sunlit Glory
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Moonlit Begonia
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Tranquil Serenade
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Eternal Seasons</color> the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Eight Sounds of Ganzhou
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Graceful Embellishment
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River

1251010.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines

1251012.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River

name: Core Passive: Eternal Seasons
Additional Ability: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
desc: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, it applies 5 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>2</color>%. For each rush attack performed during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, the Finishing Move will apply 1 extra stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {CAL:5+5,1,2} stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> are reset.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character or shares the same Faction:
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> deal 20% increased Daze. If Qingyi's Impact is greater than 120, each point over increases her ATK by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

1.name: Insulation Breakdown
1.desc: When Qingyi enters combat, <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
1.desc2:
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.

2.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
2.desc: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Eternal Seasons</color> increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
2.desc2:
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old civillization texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."

3.name: Drink Hot Water
3.desc2:
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her flask. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celsius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.

4.name: Stable Arc Barrier
4.desc: Upon entering or exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect</color> state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
4.desc2:
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."

5.name: Youthful Spirit
5.desc2:
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.

6.name: Eight Meridians
6.desc: The Interrupt Level of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color> is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
6.desc2:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"

name: Jane
description:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.

profile.impression_f: Fairy, you don't have to reiterate anything. We've all come to terms with Jane's name being Jane.
profile.impression_m: I mean, it's far from the worst name we've seen...

trust_lv.3:
Jane is a total night owl. She loves working the night shift and is most alive after dark.
She's also a bit of a hoarder, constantly filling her home with stuff (usually a bunch of junk food).

The pouch at her waist might look like a makeup bag, but it's actually her toolkit, packed with all the "essentials" for her work.

3112610.name: Jane: Hidden Nightfade
3112610.desc: Her everyday look when she isn't putting on a disguise. Maybe it's just one of the countless faces she wears. The night becomes her cover, and her mask is the one truth she never sets aside.

3112611.name: Jane: Nocturne of Light
3112611.desc: Who says sunlight must accompany a seaside stroll? For lurkers with names unknown, the night is their most faithful companion. The anonymous lady says the evening sea holds unspeakable secrets — is this the truth, or another deception?

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Dancing Blades
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Dancing Blades
Passion
descriptions.desc:
When Jane triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Upon reaching the maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>, Jane enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> regenerates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Jane exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state when all of her <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> is consumed.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Salchow Jump
descriptions.desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Salchow Jump
descriptions.desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is Invulnerable during the Finishing Move and can trigger Perfect Dodge.
If Perfect Dodge is triggered, the amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> restored when the Finishing Move hits an enemy is increased.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Phantom
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to trigger.
A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Edge Jump
descriptions.desc:

If after the first dodge, launch an upward slash in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If after the second dodge, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Phantom Thrust
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swift Shadow
descriptions.desc:

If after the first dodge, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If after the second dodge, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swift Shadow Dance
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Aerial Sweep
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>;

EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught
Chain Attack: Flowers of Sin

When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Jane directly enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state upon activating the skill, and gains max <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Final Curtain
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Jane directly enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state upon activating the skill, and gains max <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Lutz Jump
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, when the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Last Defense

When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Gale Sweep

1.name: Crime Counsel
1.desc: The maximum uses of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> are increased by one. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
1.desc2:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."

2.name: Adapt to the Environment
2.desc: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, or when any squad member triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG dealt is increased by an additional 50%.
2.desc2:
Gaze into the abyss, and it gazes back. That's only the first step.
"Then you must approach, enter, and understand it. This is the second step."
"The final step... is to resist becoming it."

3.name: Anonymity
3.desc2:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"

4.name: Adapt and Thrive
4.desc: When any squad member triggers the <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
4.desc2:
"Whether you're a hunter or the hunted usually depends on your perspective. However, I favor a more straightforward assessment—"
"The Loser is the prey."

5.name: Compulsive Hoarder
5.desc2:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"

6.name: "Shady" Technique
6.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG by 40%. After any squad member inflicts <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, Jane instantly enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, and gains max <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. When that instance of <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
6.desc2:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."

name: Seth
description:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

profile.impression_f: Seth really is a feline Thiren! He's like a kitty magnet.
profile.impression_m:
I remember seeing him being completely surrounded by stray cats on the street once.
Must be nice to be so loved by cats.

trust_lv.3:
The profile shows that Seth has an older brother who holds a higher position in Public Security.
To some, Seth is a rookie riding on family connections within Public Security, but he got in on his own merit and has nothing to do with his brother's influence.

Seth views his brother as a rival he must surpass, and is working hard to achieve that goal.

3112710.name: Seth: Incorruptible Heart
3112710.desc: He may be slow to pick up on things, slower even than the weight of the shield in his left hand, but his ability to detect evil is keener than the baton in his right.

1.name: Heroism
1.desc: The shield value provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Protector</color> lasts an additional 10s.
1.desc2:
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."

2.name: Recklessness of Youth
2.desc: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% <color=#FFFFFF>Resolve</color>. Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color> increases the move's accumulated <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> by 35%.
2.desc2:
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.

3.name: Slow Reflexes
3.desc2:
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"

4.name: Core Aspiration
4.desc: The Daze caused by <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist: Thundershield</color> is increased by 25%.
4.desc2:
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."

5.name: Distant Admiration
5.desc2:
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"

6.name: Idealist
6.desc: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color>, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
6.desc2:
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

strategy: Grants shields and Anomaly Proficiency to the whole squad

name: Piper
description:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.

profile.impression_f: Sometimes Piper says "lil ol' me" instead of "I"... Is she trying to be funny...? Or maybe she's shy!
profile.impression_m:
I think it's probably just a catchphrase.
By the way, that last part... Is Fairy trying to complain about us...?

If Piper falls asleep during a meeting, playing a recording of a truck engine can quickly get her wide awake again (this intel was provided by Lucy).

3112810.name: Piper: Lazy Speed
3112810.desc: Don't be fooled by this truck driver's lazy gaze. One tap on the gas is enough to fling every passenger's soul straight into the back seat.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Load Up and Roll Out
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Load Up and Roll Out
Dodge: Handbrake Drift
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Pedal to the Metal
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Power Drift
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleash a downward smash attack in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Pedal to the Metal
Special Attack: Tire Spin
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Piper spins and launches a sweeping slash around her, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to extend the skill duration, unleashing increasingly powerful spinning slashes and increasing the charge level of the skill up to 2 times.
If the skill is used after the first 3 hits of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, you can quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color> of an increased charge level.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: One Trillion Tons
descriptions.desc:
While <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color> is active, release <IconMap:Icon_Special> to trigger a downward smash attack based on the charge level of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color>, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Engine Spin
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, continue holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color> reaches maximum charge level to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her and dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Really Heavy
descriptions.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color>, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Piper unleashes a downward smash attack, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> reaches its limit or Energy drops to 20, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Really Heavy</color> will automatically activate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Buckle Up
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward smash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Hold~ On~ Tight~
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Brake Tap
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a downward smash attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Emergency Brake
descriptions.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Overtaking Maneuver
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Leisure Moment
1.desc: When Piper's <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>. The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color> is increased to 30.
1.desc2:
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn.
"Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"

2.name: Motivation
2.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color>, Piper's movement speed increases. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: One Trillion Tons</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Really Heavy</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>, this buff is further increased by 1%.
2.desc2:
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.

3.name: Truck Expert
3.desc2:
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant:
"100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"

4.name: Refined Techniques
4.desc: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
4.desc2:
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.

5.name: Personal Hobbies
5.desc2:
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"

6.name: Mild Excitement
6.desc: Increases the duration limit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> by 2s and extends the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color> by 4s.
6.desc2:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"

name: Hugo
description:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

profile.impression_f: Let's just say, the fact that Hugo hasn't gone off the deep end or become a sociopath is already quite the achievement.
profile.impression_m:
Sometimes I wonder what Hugo would've been like if he'd had a normal upbringing...
But then again, it's those very experiences that made him who he is.

His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.
unlock_condition: Complete Main Story "Leisurely Lull: Wandering Visitor" (available after completing Main Story Season 1 - Epilogue (B))

trust_lv.1:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.
