trust_lv.3:
Back during his time with the Ravenlock family, Hugo once ate a piece of cake that his older brother liked. In retaliation, the other children forced him to eat an entire table's worth of desserts.
Ever since, the taste of anything sweet makes him want to throw up — likely due to PTSD.
But due to his hypoglycemia, he needs sugar to keep his body functioning properly. Hugo forces himself to eat sweets over and over, pushing through the nausea to overcome the pain.
Note: Neither Lycaon nor Vivian knows about this, and Hugo once asked you to keep it a secret from them.

3112910.name: Hugo: Crownless Rebellion
3112910.desc: Never be claimed by fate. Defy its clamps, its control, its taunts, its alms, its curses, and its so-called blessings. Once you return from the abyss, it is fate that should kneel to you.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Concerto
descriptions.desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>, the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash</color>, or the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Elegy</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Phantasm
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm - Shatter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Judgment
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
Chain Attack: Trick of Fate
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Blaspheme
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Elegy
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ace Reversal
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Terminating Verdict
Additional Ability: Prelude to Finality
desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color> hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>/<color=#2BAD00>75</color>.
When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by <color=#2BAD00>500%</color>. Additionally, the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>140%</color>; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>1,700%</color>.
After Hugo triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character or shares the same attribute:
<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color>'s DMG increases by 15%, with a further increase of 35% against normal enemies. When <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the DMG dealt by the skill increases by 40%. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.

1.name: Child of Hatred
1.desc: When triggering the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.
1.desc2:
"So, do not deny your own desires, do not resist your own ambition. This is the talent you were born with, the best gift fate has ever given you!"
"Admit it, deep within your heart lies a spark, yearning to ignite a raging inferno that will burn everything down—"
"And I, am that spark."

"Yeah, I know. I've always known."

2.name: The Child Within
2.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color>, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
2.desc2:
"Family is an everlasting, unavoidable curse placed upon a person."
"No matter how much you grow, no matter where you go, that curse will forever follow you like a shadow."
"When you fall to rock bottom or climb to your peak, it will appear, turning you back into that helpless, powerless child who can do nothing but hide in the closet and weep."

"Unless you truly see him, embrace him."
Some pain can only be healed when it is seen and accepted.

3.name: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
3.desc2:
They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.
So, he broke himself into a rain of shattered pieces.
The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.

4.name: Dramatic Theory
4.desc: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
4.desc2:
Justice, evil, madness, reason, charm, stubbornness.
He's composed of countless faces.
"So, which is the real you?"
"That's not important. How about, instead, you tell me, Lycaon—"
"What kind of person do you see in me?"

5.name: Nirvana
5.desc2:
The world doesn't need to be destroyed and rebuilt, and no one has the right to do such.
But a person can.
So, he shattered himself and was reborn.
"If I must fall, let me fall. The person I am meant to become will surely catch me."

6.name: Crown of Thorns
6.desc: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> also triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.
6.desc2:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."

strategy: Triggering Totalize deals bonus DMG to Stunned enemies

name: Orphie & Magus
description:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

profile.impression_f:
Orphie has a great personality — being around her really puts you at ease!
But her obliviousness has caused Magus a fair share of grief, and she seems totally unaware of it...
profile.impression_m:
The way those two interact is pretty entertaining.
If someone made a movie starring that girl and her gun, it'd probably do pretty well at the box office.

Note: Even so, you've already uncovered plenty of weaknesses Magus tried to keep hidden. Nothing escapes your keen eyes!

3113010.name: Orphie & Magus: Two Banks of the River
3113010.desc: A soul of mirrored halves, having twice crossed the river of the dead. One side forged in fire, the other shaped into ice; one looking back on where it came from, the other watching for a new dawn. They wander on — never lost, never ceasing.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Flickering Flames
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Rush Command
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Counter Strike Opportunity
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Blazing Chamber
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Corrosive Flash
descriptions.desc:
Automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Unleashes 4 laser Aftershock attacks, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Triggers once per 5s.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex
descriptions.desc:
When off-field with 60 or more Energy, automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Performs a sweeping laser attack in an area around, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Heat Charge
descriptions.desc:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When firing begins, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption
descriptions.desc:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Dance With Fire
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When leaping into the air, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Searing Slash
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Blazing Gunblade
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Boiling Pierce
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Additional Ability: Forged in Flames
desc:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>, and Aftershock DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>42.5%</color>.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by <color=#2BAD00>130</color>. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed <color=#2BAD00>340</color>. The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
Aftershock DMG dealt by Agents with Zeroed In ignores 25% DEF.

1.name: Luxurious Cat House
1.desc: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
1.desc2:
The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"

2.name: Weird Food List
2.desc: When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.
2.desc2:
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"

3.name: "Tactics Manual"
3.desc2:
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"

4.name: Pink Holster
4.desc: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
4.desc2:
Magus never responds to empty threats, which is exactly why Orphie actually bought a pink holster.
It sits in the bottom drawer of the storage locker, serving as a constant reminder for Magus to watch her words — though with limited success.
"Captain, I've told you before, think thrice before speaking, or you'll end up hurting others!"
"Those punks deserved those bullets! Wait, Orphie... Squad Member Orphie, I order you to put that horrendously pink thing down!"

5.name: Ferry Toll
5.desc2:
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."

6.name: Magic Seed
6.desc: With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex. When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase. When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.
6.desc2:
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.

strategy: Provides ATK boost for all squad members

name: Astra Yao
description:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.

profile.impression_f: Astra just sent me another message on Knock Knock! It's a swimsuit photoshoot for "Jealous"! Wow, she's got a great body~
profile.impression_m: What?! Why don't I... Ahem, I think my phone is broken. Belle, can I borrow yours for a moment?

Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.
unlock_condition: Complete Main Story "Leisurely Lull: Goldfinch's Escape" (available after completing Main Story Chapter 5)

trust_lv.1:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.
trust_lv.3:
Astra is particularly fond of Random Play. However, her whereabouts are closely monitored. For now, it seems she can still use an excuse like, "The store offers rare versions of old movies, and I've got such good taste in movies, so of course I'd love it!" But being the biggest celebrity in Ridu, such frequent visits to a video rental store are not exactly conducive to keeping our identity under wraps.

But, who cares about that! If our identity gets exposed, so be it — Astra can't not come.
Contemplation: Creating various situations to bring Astra and Master together is a great way to win the Master's favor.

3113110.name: Astra Yao: Scarlet Rock
3113110.desc: The bold red is only to ignite the freedom deep within. On stage, nothing can overshadow her brilliance.

3113111.name: Astra Yao: Chandelier
3113111.desc: The black-and-white dress glimmers in both light and shadows. Every smile of hers seems to sink into the flowing light of the night, becoming a timeless classic.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: "Capriccio"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
During the 3rd hit, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to initiate the 3rd hit directly.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Interlude
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Chorus
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Finale
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color>.
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: "Mini Waltz"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: "Lunar Eclipse Melody"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When triggered, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} allows movement in the corresponding direction.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: "Umbrella Waltz"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly move away, then release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color>, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
During activation, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} enables movement in the direction held.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolos</color> depending on the charge duration.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

descriptions.name: Idyllic Cadenza
descriptions.desc:
After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.08+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.01,100,2}%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.015,100,2}%</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Evade> will activate a dodge. After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"</color>.
During this state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color>, exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state directly.

descriptions.name: Chord
descriptions.desc:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Chord</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when Astra Yao has <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch characters and trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, it will automatically trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: "Tipsy Concerto"
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: "Fantasian Sonata"
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and restoring <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:-50+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*250,1,2}</color> HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
After the skill, the next two <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assists</color> will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: "One Luminous Sky"
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Evasive Assist: "Two Hearts"
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: "Three Lifetimes of Fate"
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: 12-Tone Equal Temperament
1.desc: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. When activating her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, all squad members gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Song of Protection</color> for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume <color=#FFFFFF>Song of Protection</color>, granting Invulnerability for 1s.
1.desc2:
"What is the 12-tone equal temperament?"
"12-tone equal temperament is a musical tuning system, just like how children have to line up, sounds need to be in order too."
"But sounds probably don't like lining up, just like children!"
—Astra Yao's music teacher, recalling when she was six.

2.name: Art of Greed
2.desc: The ATK buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color> is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
2.desc2:
"The shiniest thing in the world is, of course, love!"
Just like a bird gathering shiny things for its nest, an artist's inner greed is probably to gather all the love in the world. By gathering all the love, one can create the most beautiful melody.

3.name: Interwoven Staff Notation
3.desc2:
A blank musical staff is a set of parallel lines that never intersect, like souls that have never met, quietly waiting for their melodies to intertwine into a song.
"Let's fill it with notes! And lots and lots of tied notes. It'll make a fantastic song!"
And that's how a new song was created, stretching across 136 bars, all connected with ties...

4.name: "Hair Upon Your Nape"
4.desc: After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> even if she does not have <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is reduced to 1s. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members enter the field via a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will inflict 50% increased Daze.
4.desc2:
One hand hovers over the piano
Not sure which note will bring me peace
A sad minor key
Or gentle melody of longing?
I seek your shadow through the score
I close my eyes, and see you more
Such as the hair upon your nape

5.name: Proxy and Silk String
5.desc2:
"Eve! I've just realized something huge — both you and {M#Wise}{F#Belle} are tall and slim!"
"...And your point being...?"
"You're both my favorite people!"
Astra beamed with joy, as if she had uncovered an earth-shattering secret.

6.name: We Are the World
6.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, the DMG multiplier for <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: "Capriccio"</color>, with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
6.desc2:
The turmoil in the world originates from the solitude of the human heart. If everyone's heart was reciprocated, perhaps all the suffering, sadness, and silence in the world would vanish?
If we could weave this connection with song, would all the cracks heal, and all the pain turn into a beautiful melody, filling the silence? At that point, the world would no longer be a lonely island.
"This song is dedicated to the world!"

name: Evelyn
description:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.

profile.impression_f: Evelyn is so cool! Can't she debut as a celebrity with Astra? I'd love to see them do a photo shoot together!
profile.impression_m: I really envy you. You can say that so easily, but if I said it, I'd probably get hit...

3113210.name: Evelyn: A Moth to Light
3113210.desc: A sharp, no-nonsense manager's outfit. Its hidden edges are enough to make onlookers back off. Her yellow-brown hair weaves a fine, delicate net, where a quiet pool of starlight seems to rest.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.

descriptions.name: Passive: Bind
descriptions.desc:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> or consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> to perform an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
Once Evelyn has 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color>, her next use of <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
descriptions.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is at 50% or higher, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a slashing attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
descriptions.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is 50% or higher, after using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color>, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Arc Step
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Locked Position
descriptions.desc:
Before entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
descriptions.desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
descriptions.desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> and with enough Energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, when Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, she will retain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target, entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
descriptions.desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, and when Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Fierce Blade
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Silent Protection
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Evelyn slashes with <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color>, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Dreamweave
1.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will be <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color>. When Evelyn attacks <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> effect lasts for 10s.
1.desc2:
The distant, blurred light seemed to be a dream she had crafted, an unreachable future. It wasn't about atonement, but a yearning for freedom.
"You want it too, don't you? A real life." An anonymous former coworker once asked Evelyn.

2.name: Dance of Fire
2.desc: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
2.desc2:
"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.

3.name: Metamorphosis
3.desc2: At that moment, she frees herself from her restraints and becomes her truest self. The tightened ropes snap, and the chains turn into a broken cocoon. Evelyn stands at the boundary of rebirth, and in her cold, sharp gaze, there is the flicker of a faint, soft glow.

4.name: Fate's Melody
4.desc: Upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
4.desc2:
"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.

5.name: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
5.desc2:
Her threads, dyed crimson like the clouds at dawn.
After each attack, she spins elegantly, blazing flames scattering like the morning light. No words are needed — Evelyn's protection has turned into a radiant flame.

6.name: Bond of Light and Shadow
6.desc: Upon launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Evelyn gains <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color> for 20s. During <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color>, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she additionally executes a <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color> will refresh the trigger count.
6.desc2:
Where there is light, there will always be shadow.
It silently hides, tracing the light's path, guarding each bright burst. The shadow never tries to steal the light's brilliance, but at every turn, it quietly fills those corners the light cannot reach. The two have never been separated, nor can they be — light is whole because of shadow, and shadow exists because of light. It's an eternal pursuit, an unspeakable connection.

name: Vivian
description:
Vivian is a member of Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck.
It's said she can predict incoming misfortune through her tears, though there's no scientific proof of this ability.
A loyal follower of Phaethon. Ever since your original account went inactive on Inter-Knot, she's been trying to track you down — digging for clues, running intense searches across the network. However, Master, she didn't find anything... all thanks to my efforts in keeping your cybersecurity airtight.
Suggestion: Until her true intentions are clear, do not reveal your identity as Phaethon.
In case you've already let your identity slip, be sure to lock your doors and wear proper sleepwear before going to bed. Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.

profile.impression_f: Vivian knows so many people and has worked in so many places... Not at all what you'd expect from how she first comes across!
profile.impression_m: Once I found out she was Sjal's senior, a lot of things suddenly made sense...

trust_lv.3:
As a child, Vivian was adopted by a man named Landon, a member of the Exaltists, and became close friends with a girl named Dina.
After Landon's crimes were exposed, Dina continued to defend her father, while Vivian broke away from the Exaltists and cut ties with her.
Vivian fell into despair for a while, hitting rock bottom — until you responded to one of her messages. That single reply gave her the hope to start trying again.
Out of respect for Vivian's wishes, I cannot tell you which message it was.
I may not fully understand human emotions, but I am certain you gave her hope and comfort when she needed it most.

3113310.name: Vivian: Fluttering Violet
3113310.desc: Maintain your elegance, Miss Vivian, from the point of your parasol, right down to your flowing skirt. Maintain your courage, Miss Vivian, through last night's lonely walk, or here today at my side.

3113311.name: Vivian: Iris of the Shore
3113311.desc: Birds soar into the starlit skies, while irises bloom by the pond. Though this enchanting moonlit night may be brief, please let me see the lingering anticipation in your eyes in the moment I bloom.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Feathered Strike
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state.
With <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> available, holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the fourth attack will activate the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and restores 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color> upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> are available after the skill, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> when the skill is used.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After activation, this skill consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>, and each one consumed grants 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, Vivian will automatically perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Featherbloom
descriptions.desc:
After any squad member hits a target with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Vivian will consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> against the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> can be stored.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Dainty Steps

When in the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> will not be triggered.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem
descriptions.desc:

1.name: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
1.desc: When a total of 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> are consumed, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG received by targets under <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color> increases by 16%.
1.desc2:
"Every morning is like our first encounter, every night a reunion."
She had once seen fate's fickleness, with the inevitable ending always tainted by tears.
She no longer wishes to be the prophetic bird of disaster. She's willing to vanish in the fire, sleep in the light, and change your fate with all she has.
So, please don't close the window; the bird will bring you love and carry away death.

2.name: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
2.desc: Vivian's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 25%. The benefits of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.
2.desc2:
"If I had never seen the sun, I could have endured the darkness."
The word "savior" feels too heavy, and "good person" seems too light.
So, perhaps it's better to say, you were once her boatman.
In that storm called malice and self-regret, you were a ray of light, guiding her through the flood.
From that moment on, she could no longer bear the curse or the nightmares. She set out on a journey to find you.

3.name: "Another and the Same"
3.desc2:
"We measure each other's shadows with the dusk, discovering they completely overlap."
In countless dusks you were unaware of, she watched the same sun set with you, turning the sea into a beautiful warmth.
Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

4.name: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
4.desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color>.
4.desc2:
"I will lay my true heart, like moonlight, to cover the path beneath your feet."
In chasing after you, she has already formed her own sky.
She is not one of vast love, nor does she have much.
But for you, only for you, she can spill moonlight, cover the darkness, and repair the fractures.
You are her only generosity, her greatest bravery.

5.name: "Sonnet"
5.desc2:
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
She is like a bird, flying from late autumn with excitement and anticipation, her wings sweeping across the winter snow. In the spring, she picks a flower and flies straight into the scorching sun of summer.
All because your eyes hide a thousand suns, she loves the fierce sunlight and fears no frost.

6.name: "Vivian"
6.desc: Vivian's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz</color>'s dash, or using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem</color>, gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. Launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color>, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>. Each additional <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, consuming a maximum of 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
6.desc2:
"Vivian is a love poem written only for you."
"We have all the time in the world."
"So, please allow me to write the rest of my life as your footnotes."

strategy: Triggering Abloom deals bonus Anomaly DMG
Attacks off-field and rapidly accumulates Anomaly Buildup

name: Zhao
description:
Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

Though she looks innocent and cute on the outside, she's actually sharp-minded, meticulous, and principled. She puts great importance on "value" and "equivalent exchange" — not in the sense of pricing things with money, but in analyzing someone's ability and potential, giving an objective and long-term assessment of the impact they can make.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

Though she rarely shows it openly, Zhao remains cautious toward kindness that comes without reason. It conflicts with her belief in "equivalent exchange," and she tends to assume the other person must have a deeper motive for offering help.
As such, when dealing with Zhao, it's best to focus on mutual benefit first. If you want to break through her defenses with sheer sincerity and goodwill, you'll be fighting an uphill battle.

There's also one piece of intel that can't be fully confirmed: Zhao loves vegetables and dislikes meat, but she seems to be pretending she enjoys meat as well.

profile.impression_f: I feel especially safe when I'm out investigating with Xiao'Zhao. Like... she's the kind of person who never loses out when dealing with others.
profile.impression_m: Whenever the group decides on something and Xiao'Zhao raises no objections, you can bet she's judged the pros and cons and found it worth attempting.

trust_lv.3:
Zhao grew up in a large family that was both poor and struggling, where affection and trust never outweighed the rule of survival: "Whoever can bring the most benefit gets more to eat."

She looked sweet and likeable, but that only made others think she was easy prey. In that harsh, predatory environment, people quickly labeled her as "low value." So her elders wrote her off as someone who'd never amount to anything, leaving her to a fate of being dismissed and abandoned. Everything changed when she met a Krampus official who saw her hidden potential instantly. From that moment on, she sealed away her past with her family, joined Krampus, and vowed to prove her true worth.
"Once you have value, you'll be seen even if you're crawling in the mud."

3113410.name: Zhao: Cuddly Executor
3113410.desc: Warm, woolly ears and a small build may invite underestimation, but the Judge of "Value" won't think twice about bringing her branch down on anyone who tries.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Glacial Judgment
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and the following four <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Final Verdict
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.12+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.01,100,2}%</color> of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out when the skill activates, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> and a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Bunny Hop
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Bouncing Dash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swift Blink
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

name: Core Passive: Ideal Colleague
Additional Ability: Crystallization
desc:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining <color=#2BAD00>0.8%</color> CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.
When Zhao activates her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> ends the existing instance before applying a new <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
When Zhao activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, all squad members' ATK increase by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When Zhao is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

1.name: Righteous Verdict
1.desc: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
1.desc2:
"Don't let that cute face fool you! I'll never forget that meeting — right there in front of a few dozen people, she pointed her finger and, with the sweetest expression, delivered the coldest verdict: 'If your company refuses any single item in this rectification list, you will be removed from TOPS. This isn't a threat — it's the objectively correct conclusion.' That image is forever etched in my mind! ...Still, I have to thank Miss Zhao."
—A company manager who revived his business after a brutal restructuring, speaking with a conflicted look as he rubbed his temples.

2.name: Krampus Senior
2.desc: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
2.desc2: Xiao'Zhao joined Krampus very early on, and even within the elite of the elite, the Krampus Compliance Authority, she's still addressed as "senior." That's how it should be... if only the juniors who came after weren't all the type who value personality over protocol.

3.name: Frostveil Edge
3.desc2: Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao.

4.name: Featherlight Footsteps
4.desc: When Zhao activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> increase by 40%.
4.desc2: Agile, light, and hard to pin down. Words once used to describe a little rabbit are now being used to describe a terrifying warrior wielding a massive blade, capable of cutting through anything...

5.name: Fuzzy Listener
5.desc2: If Xiao'Zhao's ears twitch unconsciously and perk up slightly, it means she's heard that which matters to her most. It could be intel, a mission, a deal... or praise.

6.name: No Value Has Its Own Value
6.desc: The CRIT Rate buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Ideal Colleague</color> increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.
6.desc2:
The wall of beliefs she'd built since childhood, molded by so many people, has begun to crack because of one encounter.
Xiao'Zhao now sees value differently: when something carries no listed price, it isn't useless, it's simply too precious for anything to stand as its equivalent.

name: Pulchra
description:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

profile.impression_f: I don't think she's as dangerous as Fairy suggests. She seems pretty approachable. I mean, what harm could a little kitten cause?
profile.impression_m: Just having that thought already makes it dangerous... Oh, she sent me a message saying she got me the limited edition of the game I wanted.

3113510.name: Pulchra: Rest for a Weary Tail
3113510.desc: A wandering mercenary should be out roaming the world, but the sunlight here is warm — perfect for a nap.

descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
