name: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct
Additional Ability: Business Partner
desc: When Pulchra activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, increasing the Daze she deals by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> from the previous character in the squad.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?</color>, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect for 15s. After applying <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color>, all units' <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

1.name: Self-Interest
1.desc: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color>, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
1.desc2:
"Self-interest is an instinct, but it can also be learned over time."
"How do you learn it?"
"Get burned a few times and you'll figure it out."

2.name: Opportunistic
2.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct</color>, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.
2.desc2:
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."

3.name: Territorial
3.desc2:
There's a large note posted on the door of Pulchra's car. Written in big red letters: THIS IS MY TURF! KNOCK BEFORE ENTERING! KNOCK! KNOCK!
Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!

4.name: Joy of the Hunt
4.desc: Reduces Energy Cost of activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep</color> by 5.
4.desc2:
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

5.name: Tail Game
5.desc2:
Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.

6.name: Behind the Mask
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's</color> DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Business Partner</color>'s <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect now also applies to all damage types, not just <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
6.desc2:
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.

name: Trigger
description:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.

profile.impression_f: The last time I was alone at home and running a fever, Trigger unexpectedly showed up at the store. Without even checking my temperature, she knew I had a fever of 38.6 and took care of me the whole afternoon... How did she know?
profile.impression_m: Are you asking how she knew you had a fever, or how she knew the exact temperature? I'm not sure either, but a little while ago when I sprained my ankle in the parking lot, she showed up with an ice pack almost immediately...

trust_lv.3:
According to records, Trigger originally served in the Lyre Squad of the Eridu Defense Force, Chrysoberyl Division. The other members of the squad were all killed during the fall of the old capital. Her eyes were also corrupted during this disaster. Trigger is currently working alongside the other members of her new squad to investigate the truth behind the fall of the old capital.

Trigger has a deep sense of loyalty to her companions, willing to go to great lengths for them. Master, from her actions, it is evident that she considers you a companion and has a noticeably high level of affection for you. It is likely that some event has occurred, which has left a strong, positive impression on her.

Suggestion: Offering unlimited red bean buns and round-the-clock access to soundproof rooms for harmonica playing as conditions, try negotiating a long-term partnership. This would enable you to secure extremely dependable combat strength with minimal expenditure.

3113610.name: Trigger: Gaze Into the Light
3113610.desc: In the Hollows, her aim never wavers. She's a teammate one can rely on to cover their back without question. But once she returns to Sixth Street, that constant watchfulness softens, lingering for a moment before disappearing the instant it's sensed.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cold-Bore Shot
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, the 4th hit deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Silenced Shot
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Trigger enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> and fires forward continuously, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot
descriptions.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The squad can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> once every 3s.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus
descriptions.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The same skill type can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> will immediately activate instead if triggered.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Phantom Concealment
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Vengeful Specter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Condemned Soul
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Spectral Flash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Flash Burial
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Stygian Guide
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Underworld Requiem
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Cold-Bore Cover Fire
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Delaying Demise
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Piercing Thunder
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character or shares the same attribute:

1.name: Sharpened Senses
1.desc: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.
1.desc2:
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."

2.name: "Ether Vision"
2.desc: Upon using an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, Trigger gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. When executing a Finishing Move in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, Trigger gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color> increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
2.desc2:
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."

3.name: "Homecoming"
3.desc2:
The home she could return to is now sealed away in the past.
Her cold lips pressed against the harmonica, the lonely melody the only testament to her memories.

4.name: Concealment
4.desc: When Trigger enters or extends <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disconnect</color> upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
4.desc2:
Footsteps, breaths, heartbeats. She smothers every trace of her own aura until her entire form blends seamlessly with the environment. She moves through the battlefield like a ghostly reaper.
Outside of combat though, this silent way of moving has been strictly forbidden after scaring her teammates one too many times.
Of course, she definitely hasn't been using these stealth tactics to observe the video store when she can't find an opportunity to meet someone there... right?

5.name: Locked In
5.desc2:
Once a target is locked, even with a broken, decaying body or through excruciating pain, never let your crosshair waver. From the targets of her revenge to those she must protect, from enemies to allies — this is the will of a sniper.
But with the Proxy, the one who gave her light in her darkest hour, it's not about locking in but being drawn in. Even if there's no reason to keep watching, she will never divert her aim — this is the will of a young lady.

6.name: Beyond the River of the Dead
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>. For every 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color>, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>, when Trigger hits a target in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> is consumed to deal additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
6.desc2:
"You know what? Those who are stained with blood in battle can only go to the underworld after death."
"Beyond the river of the dead lies a sight of unparalleled beauty. Flowers bloom all around me, while familiar faces from my past accompany me to my final, peaceful place of rest."
"But... because of you, because I have something to protect, perhaps I don't want that day to come so soon."

name: Yixuan

specialElement.name: Auric Ink
specialElement.title: Auric Ink
specialElement.desc: <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink</color> DMG and buffs will be calculated based on <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>. Dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> to enemies accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, which triggers the <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> effect. <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> causes the target to suffer additional <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> when attacked for a period of time. Inflicting <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> on enemies weak to <color=#FE437E>Ether</color> can interrupt their actions.

description:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.

profile.impression_f: Shifu always seems quite laid-back, as if she doesn't have any strong attachments or opinions. Perhaps, through her travels and divinations, she's seen too many people's joys, sorrows, and struggles, and fate has taken its toll on her.
profile.impression_m: Since Shifu can do divinations and tell fortunes, many things must no longer surprise her. Every change can be predicted with precision. Perhaps that's why she remains so calm and indifferent, with no desires or demands.

trust_lv.3:
When Yixuan was young, she loved eating char siu buns with her sister. but after the fall of the old capital, she lost all interest in them overnight and hasn't eaten them much since.

The disciples of Yunkui Summit are unaware of this, and just think their master is a bit picky.

Naturally, it's best to keep this a secret. Some memories and attachments should just be left to fade away with time.

3113710.name: Yixuan: Summit of Clouds
3113710.desc: As the Master of Yunkui Summit, one's fashion and accessories need only be what feels natural. Stay true to one's self.

3113711.name: Yixuan: Trails of Ink
3113711.desc: A custom attire in shades of ink. Like an elusive shadow, gone in a flash.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Auric Array
descriptions.desc:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
descriptions.desc:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.desc:

A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Skybreaker
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Nimbus Step
descriptions.desc:
When dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Enter a high‐speed <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to steer. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Banishing Blow
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
descriptions.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Charge continuously, and release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper
descriptions.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
descriptions.desc:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Rapidly dash forward and attack, followed by an explosive wing burst, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression
descriptions.desc:
With enough Technique Points, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Cloudstream Shadow
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Clear Sky Surge
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Celestial Cloud Blitz
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Grandmaster of Mysticism
Additional Ability: Auric Ink Undercurrent
desc:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color> character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

desc:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color> character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

1.name: Spiritual Path
1.desc: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Points</color>. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.
1.desc2:
"Fate is ever-changing and the path ahead uncertain. Only a pure, peaceful spirit holds firm. Even through the tides of time, I harbor no regrets."
"The mystic arts take a thousand forms, yet its core stays the same; the road may fork and falter, but the spirit stays steadfast."
"No matter the peril you face or the foe you meet, improvise as needed and face them with composure."

2.name: Ward Off Misfortune
2.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether RES</color>. Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color> extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color>, gain one stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> effect. After <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows</color>, press the Basic Attack button, or after <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break</color>, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> and launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break</color>, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> can be held at a time.
2.desc2:
"Life's twists are unpredictable — at best, the diviner discerns but a fraction."
"Dispelling misfortune and blessing rituals are merely reading the signs to pursue gain and avoid peril."
"Once you understand how to sidestep misfortune, you can just as easily cast it upon your foe... just call forth the calamity they've yet to face."

3.name: Cycle of Yin and Yang
3.desc2:
"Everything in the world follows laws of mutual generation and restraint; by understanding that principle, you can balance yin and yang to overpower your foes."
"Achieving optimal results with simple techniques isn't cutting corners, but a natural result of following the flow."

4.name: The One Path of Mysticism
4.desc: Activating an <color=#FFFFFF> Ultimate</color> grants one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tranquility</color>, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tranquility</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper</color> DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows</color> DMG increase by 30%.
4.desc2:
"It's said that countless transformations arise from a single principle. In studying the mystic arts, one must not be bound by forms but must grasp their underlying meaning."
"If you can perceive the core principles, each technique flows into another. Such is the path of the mystic: infinite forms converge into unity."

5.name: Calm Sky Vigil
5.desc2:
"To master the mystic arts, diligent study and reflection are but the start — you must learn to maintain a pure mind, listening to the wind and watching the clouds."
"When you transcend self and world, your command of Ether grows ever stronger, almost without effort."
"As you persist, you'll be able to maintain inner poise through any trial, meeting any change with unshakable calm."

6.name: Swift Yet Still
6.desc: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color>, gain a stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Point</color> cost to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> once. The <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect ends after <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> can be held. Additionally, while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Meditation</color> state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
6.desc2:
"Tranquility to govern force, motion and calm coexist. In every movement there lies a pause, and in every pause a potential for energy."
"At any moment, if your mind remains clear, you can meet endless change with unchanging focus — and strike for victory at just the right moment."
"Do you understand?"
"If not, that's okay... after silent contemplation, there comes that instant of awakening. This is yet another expression of 'swift yet still.'"

name: Soldier 0 - Anby

3113810.name: Soldier 0 - Anby: Silver Soldier
3113810.desc:
Anby's old Silver Squad uniform, stained with memories that never truly fade.
When the shadows of the past strike without warning, would you stand and face them, or stumble and flee? No matter the choice, home always awaits your return.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
On the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, enemies are continuously pulled in.
After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Strobe
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Torrent
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> will immediately cancel the current skill and launch <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color>.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Celestial Thunder
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash
descriptions.desc:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color> mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> to trigger an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> that deals 1 extra instance of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
descriptions.desc:
When the additional damage from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary
descriptions.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Thunder Smite</color> DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary</color> will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This skill counts as an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Leaping Thunderstrike
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Voidstrike
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Cloud Flash
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Counter Surge
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Conducting Blow
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Static Charge
1.desc: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> 3 times. This effect does not consume any <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> stacks.
1.desc2:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

2.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
2.desc:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 6 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> (max 6 stacks). With <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color>, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color> to hit an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> instead. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will still activate the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
2.desc2:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

3.name: Past Glory
3.desc2:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

4.name: Silver Reverb
4.desc: When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
4.desc2:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

5.name: Director's Cut
5.desc2:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

6.name: Prequel Protagonist
6.desc: Upon triggering 6 instances of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>'s additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
6.desc2:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

name: Ju Fufu
description:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.

profile.impression_f: "The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might!" I didn't expect senior Fufu to have such a side... so adorable! Hm... why does this feel like something Wise would've said?
profile.impression_m: I've never said anything like that! I still haven't totally gotten used to Fufu calling me junior when she looks so small herself, but both in life and in missions, Fufu truly is a reliable senior... How about we accidentally on purpose show her our comments? I bet she'll get really shy but feel super smug inside.

trust_lv.3:
Tiger Thirens, a Thiren race living in the mountains far from New Eridu's urban areas. Using the security camera footage in Janus Quarter, it can be extrapolated that there are no more than twenty tiger Thirens currently active in New Eridu.

During the fall of the old capital, a Hollow Zero companion Hollow disaster erupted in the tiger Thiren settlement. Records show that multiple notorious Ethereals appeared in this Hollow that swallowed up their settlement, killing 98 percent of all registered tiger Thirens. Most of the survivors were the sick, young, or elderly. If it hadn't been for a team of mystics from Yunkui Summit arriving within half an hour for search and rescue, the name Ju Fufu would likely have never appeared in your Agent records.

From Yunkui Summit's records and dates, Ju Fufu was already a disciple of the leader of Yunkui Summit, Yixuan, when the disaster happened.

3113910.name: Ju Fufu: Summit's Cute Tiger
3113910.desc: Dressed like a simple mystic, this senior sister looks like she's tucked all her bravado away, but with a tiger in her heart... she still radiates that heroic fire.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Hu Wei
descriptions.desc:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is 200.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
Dodge: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
descriptions.desc:
After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move and deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is consumed, changing the DMG to <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and granting 25 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is 15.
When consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is above 100 points, 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> will be automatically consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>.
Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> to attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game

Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Swing <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and 80 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain Attack: Tiger Cauldron Collapse

When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron
descriptions.desc:
With at least 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, automatically activate:
Consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is available, and while not the active character, the high-speed spinning state will activate after the skill ends.
This is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
Quick Assist: Decisive Stomp
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Steadfast Crouching Tiger
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Feral Blazing Maw

Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, then use <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> to follow up with a downward attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color> centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> effect: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16.7%</color>, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16.7%/33.3%</color>.
The <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>41.7</color>.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
The maximum Decibels for all characters in the squad increases by 1,000. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, that character gains 300 Decibels.

1.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
1.desc: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. When Ju Fufu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
1.desc2:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

2.name: Almighty Qingming Warrior
2.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color>.
2.desc2:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"

3.name: Righteous Young Hero
3.desc2:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

4.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
4.desc: While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
4.desc2:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"

5.name: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
5.desc2:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

6.name: Roar of My Inner Tiger
6.desc: Ju Fufu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG.
6.desc2:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

name: Alice
description:
Alice Thymefield, a new member of Spook Shack, is a young lady from the prestigious Thymefield family of New Eridu.

Alice has studied fencing and Ether science since childhood, showing exceptional talent in both fields. She currently attends Celestia School for Girls, a subsidiary of High Ambitions Academy, where she's a model student excelling in both academics and conduct. It is predicted that she will one day inherit the family business and become a next-generation Ether scholar of New Eridu.

She places extreme importance on order and patterns, showing an almost obsessive pursuit of symmetry in particular. This even affects her aesthetic judgment, making symmetry the primary criterion in determining whether something is beautiful or ugly.

Furthermore, she's easily frightened, with practically zero resistance to ghost stories and supernatural tales. Despite this, she seems to show considerable interest in encountering such phenomena. Suggestion: Master can use ghost stories as a topic of conversation with her. No matter how much she initially refuses, it is likely that she will eventually come closer to investigate.

profile.impression_f: It's rare to find someone who's just as bad with horror movies as my brother~ But even so, Alice still can't help but let her curiosity get the better of her, watching the latest horror flicks I recommend, and screaming while clinging to me. Unlike my brother, who always finds excuses to bail...
profile.impression_m: Sorry for my lack of courage... But Alice really is obsessed with the paranormal. Does she really enjoy getting scared out of her wits over and over again?

trust_lv.3:
According to my investigations, Alice has been obsessed with symmetry ever since she was young, but after experiencing the loss of her symmetrical hairpin and her father's subsequent death, she subconsciously attributed the tragedy to the loss of a symmetrical object, which intensified her obsession with symmetry.

As a prestigious family known for their Ether science research, the Thymefield family is currently facing a decline. With Alice's parents passing away early and her grandfather falling ill, and after giving away the family's patents to save a friend, she's determined to start anew and revive the family through her own strength.

Despite her timid nature, once she sets her mind on accomplishing something, she'll pursue it with unwavering determination. Moreover, she values her companions deeply and would never ignore their difficulties... Therefore, Master, I strongly recommend improving relations with Alice and informing her about our current financial struggles with paying the electricity bills.

3114010.name: Alice: Celestian Etiquette
3114010.desc: The young woman's perfect symmetry is only ever slightly compromised when she wears the school crest — such is the elegant and noble Thymefield spirit.

3114011.name: Alice: Sea of Thyme
3114011.desc:
Though it wasn't completely symmetrical, she did not mind this gift from a dear friend.
The girl pushed open the locked door and walked along the pink beach after the sudden downpour, the cool waves brushing over her ankles. There were no unknowns left to frighten her.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Celestial Overture
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Alice triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> is enhanced.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz
descriptions.desc:
When Alice's <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> reaches 1 bar, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or when <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz</color> hits, it triggers a special <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect: <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. This deals DMG equal to {CAL:0+100,1,2}% of the original <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Jumpy Bunny
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Blade-Dancer's Gale
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Ceremony of Swordlight
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Piercing Dawn
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> can be triggered.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} forward and press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Activating the skill can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and restores 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, and without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or when dragging it backwards, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Activating the skill can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and restores 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
Chain Attack: Starfall Intermission
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Starfall Finale
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Activating this skill restores 200 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Intertwined Stab
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Parry Guard
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Cross Riposte
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

After any squad member inflicts a <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> is triggered while the enemy is suffering a <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, for every 1s of remaining <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> duration, the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of {CAL:18*10,1,2}%.

When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Alice gains 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.

1.name: Palmful of Cilantro
1.desc: When Alice triggers a <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>, she gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. When she triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.
1.desc2:
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.

2.name: Sage at the Sword's Tip
2.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starfall Finale</color>'s Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. All squad members' <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG increases by 15%. <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG against enemies suffering from <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
2.desc2:
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.

3.name: Symmetrism
3.desc2:
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

4.name: Rosemary on Her Lips
4.desc: Alice ignores 10% of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. Enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Celestial Overture</color> accumulates 25% more <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>.
4.desc2:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."

5.name: Passion for the Supernatural
5.desc2:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"

6.name: A Heart of Thyme
6.desc: When Alice uses a third-stage charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starfall Finale</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Victory State</color> for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Victory State</color> again refreshes the available trigger count.
6.desc2:
The thyme-scented manor,
The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.

strategy: Ignores Anomaly Buildup and triggers Assault directly

name: Yuzuha
description:
Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.

profile.impression_f: When I first met Yuzuha, she seemed cheerful on the surface, but I always felt like she kept a certain distance from people... but that's not the case anymore.
profile.impression_m: When I saw Yuzuha's younger sister Kaede the other day, she asked me if Yuzuha had aced her exams this term. She mentioned how Yuzuha's been noticeably happier lately.

trust_lv.3:
According to Yuzuha, she's been wandering the Faunus Quarter for as long as she can remember, living as part of a small gang of street kids. She didn't have a name back then. Due to malnutrition, she had night blindness and always carried a candlestick after dark, so the others nicknamed her "Little Candle."
Yuzuha was part of an experimental project called "Project New Leaf." Since she never had a proper name, one of the lower-level researchers assigned to care for the children gave her the name "Yuzuha." However, this name was never known to Ferox or the other higher-ups — they only ever referred to her as ES-07. Despite the name coming from the lab, Yuzuha has always felt the name carried a spark of life — and that spark was part of her luck.
Both of Yuzuha's younger sisters were adopted as infants, and when Baorong named them, he continued his tradition of using names inspired by plants.

3114110.name: Yuzuha: Tanuki Under the Shade
3114110.desc: Can you tell what the umbrella conceals? A tanuki, a trap, a ghost, or a girl's sly, spirited smile?

3114111.name: Yuzuha: Tanuki in Broad Daylight
3114111.desc: Ghost stories aren't born only in shadows. Unconvinced? Just lock eyes with that playful young lady splashing in the water. She'll possess your thoughts, while Kama sneaks away with your drink.

Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot
descriptions.desc:
When Yuzuha has <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color>.
