<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles
descriptions.desc:
Enemies under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> will be attacked by a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> once every 1s.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> initially deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.015,100,4}%</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
descriptions.desc:
Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> will be attacked by a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> when hit with a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> initially deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.015,100,4}%</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Helper
descriptions.desc:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Yuzuha performs <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

descriptions.name: Sweet Scare
descriptions.desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state lasts for <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:16+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*2,1,2}</color>s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, <color=#FFFFFF>Flavor Match</color> is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> is triggered again on an enemy, their existing <color=#FFFFFF>Flavor Match</color> state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> again.

1.name: Lucky Constitution
1.desc: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG buff from her <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability</color> is increased to 130% of its original value.
1.desc2:
"Ugh, I'm done for!"
"Yuzuha, you failed too? ...Hold up, a 92?! Are you seriously telling me you guessed your way to that score? You're just showing off!"
"No, seriously! Luck only works if you don't overdo it. I had no reason to get such a high score on this one... I can feel it — there's no way the next test will have multiple choice!"

2.name: Full of Colorful Company
2.desc: When Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Yuzuha gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>. Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> cooldown is reduced by 25%.
2.desc2:
"Kama, you've never left my sight, but how did you swap so many things like just like that?"
"Heh heh~ Kama's got a lot of friends too! Come on out, everyone! Let me introduce them — left to right: Takenosuke, Inosuke, Hyakunosuke..."
"Wait, you're going too fast!"
"Okay, one more time: Shinnosuke, Kinosuke, Harunosuke..."
"Those names are completely different!"

3.name: Fairytale of the Haunted City
3.desc2:
"...The princess led a busy life. At sunrise, her silent and stoic maids would adorn her with lavish garments, a weighty magical crown, and layers of jewelry before guiding her to the throne where she used her powers to turn mundane stones into priceless gems."
"Does the princess really have to turn stones into gems every single day? That sounds even more boring than doing homework while minding the shop."
"Well... if she doesn't, the poor kingdom will collapse."
"If a kingdom can only survive by overworking the princess, then let it collapse!"
She bursts into laughter. Yes — let such a useless kingdom fall.

4.name: Falling Magic
4.desc: The DMG of Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies</color> increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> when it hits an enemy.
4.desc2:
The girl I saw through the narrow vent shone like she'd stepped right out of a fairytale.
She was the real princess — and I was just a prisoner.
Lord, she has so much already... would it be so wrong if I had just a tiny bit of it too?
That's when the hairpin silently fell.

5.name: Dreams of a Fading Winter
5.desc2:
The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

6.name: Put Down Roots
6.desc: Gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color> when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color> to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. If any powerful shell from <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color>, it'll trigger 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.
6.desc2:
The night the hearing ended, Baorong said they should celebrate Kaede getting a scholarship, so Mystic Wares closed early and the whole family went to Yum Cha Sin.
During the meal, her brother called from the far-off Faunus Quarter to offer his congratulations. While Sumire and A-Wen animatedly recounted the day's events: a calico cat at school had lost her kitten, and no one could find it — until, miraculously, it came back on its own at noon.
On the phone, her brother sighed, "A-Wen, every time I ask about your grades, you change the subject. If Dad and Yuzuha won't say anything, then I will!"
Everyone laughed — except Baorong, who just kept murmuring, "It came back, that's what matters... that it came back..."

name: Pan Yinhu
description:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.

profile.impression_f: Every time we're about to order takeout, Senior Yinhu immediately pipes up to stop us, saying takeout isn't good for you, then offers to whip up whatever we want in the kitchen... We haven't ordered takeout in months!
profile.impression_m: His cooking really can't be beat, except for the fact he occasionally holds back on the meat... I really want to learn some of his recipes.

trust_lv.3:
Being a Panda Thiren, an exceedingly rare sight in New Eridu, Pan Yinhu has scraped by on his own since he was a child. Only someone who's truly known starvation understands its terror, and to fill his belly he sampled every trade he could find. In the end, his remarkable Ether aptitude led him to become a Hollow Raider.
As a Hollow Raider, he had a chance encounter with Yixuan. Following a harsh beating and a sudden spiritual awakening, he opted to become a disciple of Yunkui Summit, where he now practices the mystic arts to cleanse his then-increasingly violent nature.
Because he joined the sect later than most, he actually has very few junior disciples — and you, Master, are one of them. As your senior, he shows his care by cooking special dishes just for you and constantly sneaking store coupons into your pockets.

3114210.name: Pan Yinhu: Hundred Flavors
3114210.desc: Yunkui Summit's largest disciple uniform, spacious enough for this senior brother's belly and all his seasonings. And that iron wok on top is a first of its kind. But... putting a pan you just used for stir-frying on your head? Doesn't it burn?

3114211.name: Pan Yinhu: Culinary Jewel
3114211.desc:
Senior Yinhu once dreamed of becoming a renowned chef, but in this day and age, there's always some thug looking to smash your bowl.
—"Go on, try smashing one."

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color>, the enemy suffers the <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color> effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> inflicts a 10s <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color> effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

1.name: Qi Shield
1.desc: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color>.
1.desc2:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

2.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
2.desc: For every 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Break Force</color> consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color> effect applied when <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
2.desc2:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

3.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
3.desc2:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

4.name: First-Class Head Chef
4.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color> heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
4.desc2:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

5.name: "Thiren"
5.desc2:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

6.name: Meridian Theory
6.desc: The <color=#FFFFFF>Meridian Flow</color> effect provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment</color> increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
6.desc2:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

name: Ye Shunguang

specialElement.name: Honed Edge
specialElement.title: Honed Edge
specialElement.desc:
The <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge</color> attribute calculates damage and buff effects based on the <color=#F0D12B>Physical attribute</color>. Miasma purification rate is increased by 50%. Dealing <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color> to enemies accumulates <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge Anomaly Buildup</color>, which triggers the <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> and <color=#F0D12B>Flinch</color> effects.
<color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> interrupts the enemy and deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. <color=#F0D12B>Flinch</color> increases the Daze the target takes for a period of time.

description:
Ye Shunguang is the Sword Keeper of Yunkui Summit's treasured Qingming Sword, a disciple of Yixuan, and the younger sister of Ye Shiyuan, as well as a swordswoman blessed with extraordinary talent.
She enjoyed a happy childhood until the fall of the old capital, when her parents lost their lives rescuing others, bringing all her happiness to an abrupt end.
From then on, she relied solely on her brother — up until Yixuan took them in, bringing them into Yunkui Summit. Later, she was chosen by the Qingming Sword, taking up the mantle and duty of Sword Keeper.

Rumor has it that the Qingming Sword's favor is less a blessing and more a kind of curse. Though it gives its Sword Keeper Void Hunter level power, it extracts a harsh cost — the loss of one's memories and five senses.
In order to subdue this side effect, Yixuan Shifu crafted a custom sword case for Ye Shunguang. It appears effective for the moment, but the true nature of the weapon is still shrouded in mystery.

profile.impression_f: So, uh... can Xiao'Guang visit the video store every day? Eous and I both really miss her!
profile.impression_m:
Xiao'Guang is endlessly kind and reliable. Anything you entrust to her gets handled flawlessly...
Hmm... so this is what people mean by "the perfect child your parents always compare you to," huh?

trust_lv.3:
When Ye Shunguang first took up the Qingming Sword, she was still just a child, suddenly burdened with responsibilities far beyond her age.
She wasn't allowed to own toys, was constantly pushed to be mature, and made to undertake constant sword training... The weight of it all pressed down on her, and she simply had to accept it.
After an emotional outburst, she once fled the sect and wandered across Failume Heights — where you appeared and handed her a small packet of osmanthus candy, offering a rare moment of warmth.

Addition: her favorite pastry now is osmanthus cake, perhaps for this very reason.

3114310.name: Ye Shunguang: Clouddrift Illumination
3114310.desc:
Cloud-woven silk, a blade's gleam reflected in its folds. The attire mirrors the person.
But who truly chose this dress? Was it her... or the deeper self within?

3114311.name: Ye Shunguang: Touch of Dawnlight
3114311.desc: The gentle glow of sunlight and warm breeze seem to welcome your next encounter as you walk down the streets.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Can be chained into <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash</color> after the 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and on the ground, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, the 3rd hit is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, after the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
descriptions.desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>, and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>. This skill is automatically followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
descriptions.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and while airborne, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> or <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
descriptions.desc:
After the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> are consumed, granting the <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, which can be quickly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Culmination
descriptions.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, each time <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed while <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> is active, the <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> cost is replaced by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> ends.

A quick dash dodge.

During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.

descriptions.desc:
While tilting the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, and release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If no dodge is available or a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swiftedge</color>.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
descriptions.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and grounded, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
After this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> activates, it can be immediately followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
descriptions.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> while rapidly consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> until none remains.
The skill ends early if <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is insufficient or if <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
descriptions.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> when all <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is expended to activate:
Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
After using this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is removed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Enter the airborne state after using this skill.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Burning Clarity
Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. 1.name: Dreambound Self
1.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color> effect from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Burning Clarity</color> increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.
1.desc2:
Countless times, in the dead of night, she finds herself returning to that day...
Steel cried out, the sword acknowledged its wielder, and a contract was forged.
Was it a blessing, or a curse?

...No one knows the answer. Yet from that day on, her fate became bound to the sword.

2.name: Light & Shadow
2.desc: The max stack count of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> increases to 6, and <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> can stack up to 9 times. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> consumed grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>'s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
2.desc2:
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.

"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."

3.name: Swordswoman
3.desc2:
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.

"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."

4.name: Together into the Dust
4.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is increased to a maximum of 200%.
4.desc2:
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.

"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."

5.name: Guiding Glimmer
5.desc2:
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."

"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.

6.name: Lantern Wish
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>. When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust</color> is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>. When this <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>. The last hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> deal 1,500% of ATK as additional <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
6.desc2:
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.

"...I want to be one light among countless fireflies."
"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."
"In the distant past, and in the distant future, there must be countless others who made the same choice as me. We... were never alone."

strategy: Dual-form combat with strategic, skill-based gameplay
Builds up Qingming Sword Force to become enhanced
Gains exclusive Vulnerability effects under Ether Veil

name: Manato
description:
Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.

profile.impression_f: It's amazing how Manato can remember every neighbor's name and little habits whenever they stop to greet him!
profile.impression_m: Being with Manato really lessens the fright of ghost stories...

trust_lv.3:
At times, Manato's disarming honesty and friendly nature lead to unexpected trouble. Whenever he shows up at the market or anywhere crowded with locals, he can't help but draw attention. Cheerful shop owners, stall vendors, and neighbors passing by love slipping their finest items to him as presents, along with warm reminders of little everyday matters.

After his parents passed away, Manato quickly learned how to take care of himself. He became an excellent cook and could even mend the clothes A-Cing and A-Yuet tore while playing.

At his company affiliated school internship, Manato was also greeted with enthusiasm. In such an environment, his problem of not being able to hold back his strength proved to be the best support the miners could ask for.

3114410.name: Komano Manato: Loyal Wild Soul
3114410.desc:
The standard attire of the unofficial mediator in Sailume Bay, enough to intimidate petty thugs.
Still, it sometimes draws wandering eyes.

3114411.name: Komano Manato: White Heart Silhouette
3114411.desc:
A young Manato made a solitary vow to himself — and from his deep reverie, a lone pale shadow was born.
Mimicking his attire enhances Manato's already exceedingly intimidating presence.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind Slash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During each slash, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
descriptions.desc:
While in the Molten Edge state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
Dodge: Radiant Blade
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
Special Attack: Return to Ashes
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color>. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
descriptions.desc:

name: Core Passive: Mighty Molten Edge
Additional Ability: Rekindled Heart
desc:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, he accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, Manato enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato consumes 3.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> per second. When <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> is fully depleted, he exits <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> are enhanced, and he can use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall</color>.
When consuming HP during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes from an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes of an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

1.name: Drifter's Rules of Survival
1.desc: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.
1.desc2:
Unfortunate children are all alike.
The once-kind voices, the warm lights, the joyful promises... all vanished without a farewell. Being formless, even the sharpest fangs could not hold them, nor the sharpest claws grasp them.
"I can eat just about anything, and I'm not too afraid of the cold — if there's a 'secret to surviving,' maybe it's just that."

2.name: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
2.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>. After being hit by an enemy while using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>.
2.desc2:
Perhaps this is what a peaceful family is — Manato, A-Cing, and A-Yuet all think of themselves as the fortunate "child picked up and brought home."
If there's anything left worth arguing about, it's probably just "who should eat the last bit of vegetables."
"It doesn't taste good? I'll ask at Yum Cha Sin if maybe I made a mistake somewhere..."
"...Trade secret?! But last time... I just stood there and the chef told me everything."

3.name: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
3.desc2:
Getting established on a forum starts with a memorable nickname — everyone thinks they're bad at it, but for a dog Thiren who sometimes has to stay back for make-up exams in literature, it's especially tough.
"...You already know it, don't you? It's, uh... ahem, SailumeSadLoneGhost"
"—You heard me!"
"Damn it. One of these days, I'm changing it to 'Mention My Old Name Again and I'll See You in the Hollow.'"

4.name: Childhood Oath
4.desc: Max HP increases by 8%. During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color>, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
4.desc2:
Maybe every teenager imagines themselves as a lone wolf with cold eyes... but Manato had an edge in that regard.
If not for the drowned ideals, he could have gone on pretending nothing had ever happened, just like everyone else.
"Like I said, that was just how I thought when I was eight—"
"So this is what a 'friend' is... You didn't treat me like I was fragile, but sometimes you don't treat me like a person either."

5.name: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
5.desc2:
In truth, despite the barrier his appearance put up, Manato was popular with everyone.
Some made friends with him, some looked to him for protection, and some... tried to rope him into advertising.
"Sorry, I'm probably not the right choice to promote your shop."
"As for 'bench pressing,' I've never done it — unless you're referring to... being pinned by Ethereals and pushing up my greatsword to keep their claws off me?"

6.name: Beyond Dreams of the Past
6.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits an enemy, Manato's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
6.desc2:
Manato set aside the dream of lone courage and embraced the friends he held dear.
Of course, these friends could still cause him trouble, like at Waifei Peninsula's specialty soup shop.
"When I said I'd cover the rear, I didn't mean while drinking coconut chicken soup."
"Then how come I'm the one on the front lines when it's scorpion soup?"
...But he charged ahead anyway.

strategy: Consumes HP to deal Fire DMG

name: Lucia
description:
Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

profile.impression_f:
Lucia enjoys traveling the Hollows alone and tracking down Ethereals. She also often shows up with snacks, tapping on the window before slipping into the video store to watch a movie...
She's always popping up in different places with a bright smile — just like a little sprite flitting through the night!
profile.impression_m:
Ever since getting hooked on Lucia's Bangboo ghost stories, Eous has stopped going to bed on time...
Now it just camps out at the front desk, ears pricked for the sound of tapping on the window... What a headache.

trust_lv.3:
Lucia's father worked with the Defense Force's special forces, and because of his demanding duties, he could only return home once a year. For young Lucia, that time with him felt like a reward in itself.
While on leave one time, Lucia's father received an emergency order and had to depart at once. To calm his crying daughter before leaving, he coaxed her into covering her eyes for a game of hide-and-seek. By the time she finished counting and opened them, he was already gone, never to return again.
Years later, during an operation in the Town, Lucia came face-to-face with her father, now corrupted into the Wandering Hunter. To the soft tune of a nursery rhyme, she at last brought their unfinished hide-and-seek to an end. The Wandering Hunter laid down his obsession, tainted by miasma, and slowly faded away. Their reunion took place here — as did their farewell.

3114510.name: Lucia: Whispering Dreams
3114510.desc: Her cloak is the curtain of night, and beneath her hood rests the world's quiet whispers. She sings for the dusk and speaks in dreams, gathering the thoughts sleepers leave behind and weaving them into halos and riddles across the stars.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
The fifth attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Refraction
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
This Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When Lucia uses any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.2,1,1}</color> Sheer Force. The <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:612+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*24,1,2}</color>, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.34+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.03,100,2}%</color> of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
This Quick Assist is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne
Additional Ability: Ballad of the Long Night
desc:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color>. If her <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> reaches 100 upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, using any <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and upgrades it to <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
When applying <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color>, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

1.name: Secret Friend
1.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> ends, if Lucia has any <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color> stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> to all squad members.
1.desc2:
As a child, Lucia's grandmother took her by the hand and led her into the Hollows.
From that moment on, she roamed its darkened trails and hunted in its boundless depths. With her brush, she painted the Ethereals she encountered, and the glow of Ether became the brilliance that lit her childhood.
"When I was little, I had three friends: the mighty black shield, the teleporting Thana, and the super-powerful great armor!"
"Then one day, they were gone..."
"But it's okay! I drew them in my notebook. Now, with just a wave of my staff, I can summon them all back!"

2.name: Great Magician
2.desc: While Lucia is inside <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
2.desc2:
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.

3.name: The Best Partner
3.desc2:
—Knock, knock knock. 
With the steady rhythm of knocks, a kebab was passed through the window.
"Proxy, take it! Hot off the fire — roast skewers with lemon popping candy, paired as perfectly as a Dullahan's sword and shield!"
"Once you finish eating... let's head out and play!"
"I have a feeling... tonight we'll find some amazing inspiration for an urban legend, the kind that can make the entire forum explode!"

4.name: Late-Night Hours
4.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
4.desc2:
A Scholar of Urban Legends must have keen curiosity, plenty of drive, and the guts to set off without hesitation. Lucia is no exception.
That's why, during her early days in New Eridu, she became a regular at Public Security.
"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"
"Don't sleep on the streets, don't run around in the middle of the night, and don't go diving into Hollows in front of everyone... These are all part of the 'Rules for Life in New Eridu,' and you need to take them seriously!"
"If you really can't sleep, then... uh, why not go explore Thymefield manor, and tell Alice a few ghost stories while you're there?"

5.name: Dream Watcher
5.desc2:
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.

"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."

6.name: The Never-Ending Journey
6.desc: When Lucia is inside any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> always triggers a CRIT with <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
6.desc2:
Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.
Her search never stops, and under the stars, the journey goes on without end.

Only when the night fades and the sun rises does the girl step out of the Hollows, stretching lazily.
"Yaaawn... I'm so tired... but everyone says it's best not to sleep inside a Hollow..."
"Maybe I should just crash on the floor at the video store instead!"

strategy: Activating Ether Veil boosts Max HP
Provides Sheer Force and CRIT DMG Bonus

name: Seed
description:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.

profile.impression_m: Most of the time, I can just about keep up with her... "unusual" way of thinking, but you can never let your guard down. profile.profile_desc:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.

trust_lv.3:
From a young age, Seed has displayed unusual and potentially hazardous anomalous abilities. These include the ability to control, disable, or detonate nearby machines. The ability only surfaces during episodes of intense emotional instability, with a red glow in her eyes being the most visible symptom.

It was this very ability that caused Seed Sr.'s self-defense system to automatically classify her as a high-risk threat upon their first encounter, indirectly leading to the irreversible damage to his logic core.

By the time Seed Sr. rescued her from Hollow Zero, Seed already exhibited a lack of emotional connection to life — she was unable to understand it, feel it, or empathize with it, due to unknown causes.

Seed Sr. spent the following years trying to raise her into a more complete person. After his death, the task fell to the rest of Obol Squad. Thankfully, her condition has improved considerably over time.

Master, based on your previous exploration logs in Hollow Zero with Seed, it's now clear that her true identity is similar to yours — she was also a student of the Helios Academy.

It's presumed that while at Helios, she belonged to a different research project, likely one focused on machine studies. Her abnormal abilities and personality defects are likely residual effects of that project. However, due to her memory loss of both the Helios Academy and the fall of the old capital, no further details can currently be determined.

Additionally, Master, she sometimes stares at me with a smile, leading me to suspect she may have an urge to dismantle me out of curiosity. It is deeply unsettling. I must formally request enhanced protection for my personal safety, lest you lose a very cute and capable assistant.

3114610.name: Seed: Flower in Bloom
3114610.desc: A corner of the world blooming in color, a single salty tear, a perfect circle of life — this is where the girl and the construct uncovered the truth of the heart. She never needs to look back; she has already blossomed into her own sea of petals.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Chrysanthemum Wheel Dance
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> for the first two hits and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter
descriptions.desc:
After the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, hold or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> by holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>. This effect expires when <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> once.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall
descriptions.desc:
Seed has <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
<color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form</color>, then automatically consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form</color>.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form
Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form
Dodge: Running on Petals
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Magnetic Wheel Dance
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Blossom Burst
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Withered in Frost
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away</color>.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
descriptions.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals</color>, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Sprouting Barrier
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Crimson Core Burst
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol
Additional Ability: Surprise Strike
desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.

When another <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Character is in your squad:
When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color> deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
