When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color> deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.

name: Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol
Additional Ability: Surprise Strike
desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>1,000</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>1,000</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.

When another <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Character is in your squad:
When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color> deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.

1.name: "Hibernation Period"
1.desc: When Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 100, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> can be triggered, and the total <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> required to gain one chance to quickly release <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> when entering the battlefield/using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. Increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> CRIT DMG by 30%.
1.desc2:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

2.name: "Light Absorption Technique"
2.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals</color>, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals</color>, the following <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>'s DMG increases by 5%.
2.desc2:
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

3.name: "A Story of Sprouting"
3.desc2:
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

4.name: "Fragrant Tune"
4.desc: When Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by 20%.
4.desc2:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

5.name: "Time to Bloom"
5.desc2:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."

6.name: "Theory of the Heart"
6.desc:
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
6.desc2:
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."

name: Banyue
description:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.

profile.impression_f: Banyue Shifu may look calm and composed, but he's actually got a timid side! Last time he visited Suibian Temple, a mouse happened to scurry in, and though he did his best to hide it, it was clear he was unsettled...
profile.impression_m: Come to think of it, one time, a kid dropped a marble, and he kept looking at it... I guess Banyue Shifu isn't always the composed martial arts master he seems to be.

trust_lv.3:
Banyue's true identity is that of a killing machine secretly developed years ago by TOPS, specifically designed to suppress Miasma and codenamed "Purge Unit - Type Zero." The algorithm implanted within him drives him to act according to the most logical solution for eliminating Miasma, which often results in indiscriminate annihilation of all moving targets within sight, including both the Miasma and affected civilians.

After a failed operation, Banyue, then still a mere machine, was abandoned by TOPS, but was then discovered by a sage visiting the Lemnian Hollow, who rewrote his Core and constructed new intelligent logic for him, allowing Banyue to gradually develop self-awareness. Later, Banyue was accepted by the residents of the old mining site in Waifei Peninsula, where he integrated into "human" life.

During the catastrophic Miasma outbreak at the old mining site ten years ago, Banyue rushed to rescue the civilians, yet under the influence of his perfectly rational algorithms, he abandoned those he deemed beyond saving. Though he saved the young Ye Shunguang and Ye Shiyuan, this planted a deep-seated guilt within him for "abandoning those in need." As a result, Banyue never took the Forbidden Fruit test, and despite meeting the criteria of an Intelligent Construct, he remains officially unrecognized as one.

After receiving judgment from Dialyn, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, Banyue resolved to atone for his past regrets by protecting the future. Through Dialyn's recommendation, he has now become a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, embarking on a completely new journey.

3114710.name: Banyue: Blazestone Heart
3114710.desc: He carries a righteous, unshakable aura — every bit the master he is. Don't judge him by his silence; a stone heart makes no sound, and compassion doesn't speak aloud either.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain
descriptions.desc:
When Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> and activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks
descriptions.desc:

Banyue automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Immovable Mountain
descriptions.desc:

Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Overcome Peaks

After any <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> and quickly execute the required inputs during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> to then follow up with the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Scattering Sands
descriptions.desc:

After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Stoneburst

Launches a forward attack that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: One With the Mountains
Additional Ability: Mountain's Zenith
desc:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> when parrying an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, and recover 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When he possesses at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state by using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue can no longer gain <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. After Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, he exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, remove all <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>.
When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>150</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, when Banyue consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color> increases his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1.name: Greed Burns Like Fire
1.desc: When Banyue hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, he inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state. In this state, enemies' <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
1.desc2:
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

2.name: Anger Cuts Like a Blade
2.desc: The CRIT DMG bonus from the <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive</color> is increased by an additional 15%, and the <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> bonus is increased by an additional 15%. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
2.desc2:
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.
But when it stirs with the wrath of the heavens, even the fiercest of beasts will tremble in fear.

"Anger is like a blade — keep it sheathed in daily life, lest it wound those around you."

3.name: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
3.desc2:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."

4.name: Purge Unit - Type Zero
4.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> DMG increase by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color>.
4.desc2:
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."

5.name: Student
5.desc2:
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."

6.name: Descended Vidyaraja
6.desc: At any time, when Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, he also gains <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. The <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> bonus from <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color> is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color>, Banyue deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> immediately after an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> also grants <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>.
6.desc2:
"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.

"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."

strategy: Increases Sheer Force, CRIT DMG, and Fire DMG for himself

name: Dialyn
description:
Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Center, though few know her other identity — a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.

profile.impression_f: She might seem to switch back and forth between jokes and sarcasm, but if you have the patience to listen closely, you'll find that deep down, Dialyn is someone with strong principles and real courage!
profile.impression_m: Dialyn may come across as a little harsh sometimes, but she's the type to always speak up against injustice and be honest with her friends. She's even the one who told me about Belle sneaking out to hang out with our Agents without me.

trust_lv.3:
"Curse" — not just a word for the torment of those endless voices of the dead echoing through the Hollows, but also for the ill fate brought by such a sinister gift.

Before a secondary Hollow outbreak, Dialyn's neighbors, misled by a construction company, turned on her, sending the "ill-omened" child into a Hollow as a sacrifice for their own safety.

Naive to humanity's cruelty but kind at heart, the young Dialyn willingly offered her life to save everyone, but upon stepping into the Hollow, her accursed gift revealed the cruel truth: it had all been a scheme by the construction company. The residents — whose lives had been covered by massive insurance policies — were doomed to die within the Hollow, and Dialyn was simply the bait to keep them from fleeing.

She heard her secret curse betrayed, the hatred the dead had towards her, the voices of all who perished, and the lies of those who lived. She can no longer recall how she made it through that barren wasteland. But ever since Krampus took her in, she's been ready: Amid the unending struggle between lies and truth, she would learn to pass her own judgment on good and evil.

3114810.name: Dialyn: Ringing Judgment
3114810.desc: A sweet voice comes from the receiver, and when you lean in to listen, it softens into a gentle whisper, announcing that the verdict has arrived... just kidding, it's just a standard satisfaction survey.

name: Core Passive: Five-Star Service Hotline
Additional Ability: External Line
desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.4</color> for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color> for 8s.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> for 8s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> effect. While under <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> per second. When a heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits enemies, she gains 7.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window using <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Welcome Mat</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Forward Call</color>, the next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. When an ally launches an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> this way, Dialyn consumes 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> and doesn't trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window, she consumes 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> to forcibly trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window. The next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> reaches 90 or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>. A maximum of 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> can be held at a time.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
Dialyn's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect. While <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> while <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, if the remaining duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent's Sheer Force.

1.name: Boundless Hospitality
1.desc: The amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> accumulated each second and gained when <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy increase by 16%. While the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.
1.desc2:
Welcome to the Cross-Department Customer Service Center!
Our motto is simple: always wear a smile, always greet every customer with passion~!
A smile... the one expression I once found hardest to fake. When did it become second nature to me?
"Hello there, darling~ How can I help you? Well~ not that I really can do anything for you!"

2.name: 24/7 Hotline
2.desc: Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>.
2.desc2:
TOPS is the biggest corporate alliance in New Eridu, and our work keeps this city alive~!
We're the essential lubricant that keeps this great machine turning, so our service hotline must stay open 24/7, no matter what!
Endless noise and constant chatter? No problem — that's what I know best.
"Please feel free to contact me anytime~! No matter when you do, I'll still be just as annoying~!"

3.name: Call From the Hollow
3.desc2:
The Hollows are a vast tomb, where every echo of life falls silent within its pitch-black coffin.
But to me, it's a call I can never refuse, the final page of every diary, a memo of obsession and lingering resentment.
Even if... all that talk of letting go or holding on, they've got nothing to do with my own story.
"It's alright! I've talked with plenty of clients far harder to communicate with than you~!"

4.name: The Past Never Fades
4.desc: Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. While the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.
4.desc2:
People always treat me like a kid because I'm small, but my childhood is long since over.
Which day did it end, though? The first time I heard the whispers of the dead? When I was sent into the Hollow as a sacrifice? Or that first night I cried myself to sleep?
With no one to protect me, I had to find my own footing. Unable to forget the past, I pretended to let it go.
"I don't care about your personal issues~ but I am very concerned about how your childhood trauma might affect my complaint rate~!"

5.name: Lies
5.desc2:
We lie when others still care about us, and only tell the truth once they've stopped.
Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.
I know people always lie, but at least there are still some who bother to lie to me.
"My suggestion? Mix a bit of flattering nonsense in between your insults — it'll work in your favor~!"

6.name: Truth
6.desc: When an ally enters the field with an Ultimate through the <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive</color>'s effect, that ally gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Aftertone</color> effect. With this effect, landing an attack causes Dialyn to deal an additional instance of <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 480% of Dialyn's ATK. This DMG is treated as <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG, and can trigger once every second, up to 12 times. Gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Aftertone</color> again refreshes its trigger count. Only one ally can have <color=#FFFFFF>Aftertone</color> at a time.
6.desc2:
A sudden death is like a moment preserved in time, capturing truth in its final, immutable form.
I take these specimens from the hands of the dead, using their death certificates as the foundation for my judgments.
Pure, objective "truth" is the only rule I can depend on, the only thread guiding my way forward... until—
"Proxy, can I lie as well?"

strategy: Can upgrade Chain Attack to Ultimate

name: Sunna
description:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"

profile.impression_f:
Sometimes Sunna reminds me of some kind of rare creature in a game — she only spawns under very specific conditions!
Last time, I had to bug her for a whole week just to get her to go clothes shopping with me!
profile.impression_m: Yeah, I've had my fair share of Belle's nonstop badgering... I bet Sunna couldn't handle it either.

trust_lv.3:
Sunna has a weakness for sweets that look cute, which often leads her to buy treats that are all looks and far too sugary — something Nangong never misses a chance to tease her about. Even so, when Nangong and Aria pick out gifts for Sunna, they always settle on cupcakes with colorful, eye-catching designs.
Sunna also loves things with gentle, fragrant scents and often makes scented candles herself, as they help her focus her thoughts and spark inspiration. Once she enters her own "musical kingdom," she becomes so absorbed that she can barely hear anything from the outside world.
Note: According to Aria, Sunna once burned Nangong's limited-edition teapot dry while writing a song. To make it up to her, Sunna spent more than two weeks serving tea and running errands for Nangong as an apology.

3114910.name: Sunna: Dreams on Loop
3114910.desc: Put on the outfit she finds cutest, and she can break free from the crowd, slipping into the lingering echoes of delusion.

3114911.name: Sunna: Afternoon Tea Break
3114911.desc:
Freshly baked cake, rich aromatic coffee, and the warm afternoon sun...
Wrapped in moments of softness, it's time to begin today's tea break.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Mischief Meteor Hammer
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted
descriptions.desc:
During combat, when Sunna is off-field and there are no enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, Bubblegum consumes 1 Claw Sharpener to automatically launch an attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When any squad member activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, Sunna gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpeners</color>.
When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Sunna gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color>. This effect can trigger at most once every 10s.
Bubblegum inherits Sunna's initial ATK. Sunna can hold up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpeners</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Can't Hit Me
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Skyward Hammer
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Delusion Strikeout
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a series of hammer blows, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Star Shooter
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Shoots Bubblegum to attack enemies in front using an air gun, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Hurls Bubblegum at the target, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Upon activating this skill, all Agents in the squad gain Angelic Chord-ination for 40s.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique
descriptions.desc:
While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate, or during <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to quickly activate:
Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Before the heavy attack is executed, activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will cancel the existing instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique</color> can be used once each time Sunna enters the Angelic Chord-ination state.

Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Charges forward on Bubblegum, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Smash It All!
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
After a series of hammer attacks, launches Bubblegum to cause an explosion, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in an area.
On activating the heavy attack, gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpeners</color>.
Upon landing the downward attack from above on an enemy, triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and restores <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:-50+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*250,1,2}</color> HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat
Quick Assist: Sonic Beatdown
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes a series of hammer attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Stage Fright
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Jump Training
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Continuously jumps forward on the inflatable hammer, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in front.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Cuteness Is Justice
Additional Ability: Daydreamer's Counterpoint
desc:
Characters in the <color=#FFFFFF>Angelic Chord-ination</color> state gain increased ATK, equal to <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>525</color> ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 1,750, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> to the target for 12s. While Sunna is the currently active character, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>150%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>240%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>80%</color>.
DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, only the primary attack target's <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered. Upon triggering, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is significantly reduced.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When characters inside <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> land attacks on enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.
When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone mode, the effect can trigger once every 180s.

1.name: "Loneliness Corruption Symptoms"
1.desc: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> triggers and damages an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
1.desc2:
It didn't matter if no one understood her. As long as she had music, that was enough. It didn't matter if no one ever talked to her first, either. She'd never expected them to anyway...
Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music.
"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.

2.name: "Feline Go-With-the-Flow"
2.desc:
While Sunna is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.
2.desc2:
"That kid's an odd one, always humming strange songs alone in the corner..."
Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.
Then, one warm and gentle afternoon, a dark-haired girl stretched her hand out like an angel.
Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.

3.name: "Transformation Apple"
3.desc2:
She has never before received praise from so many strangers.
"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

4.name: "Delusion Investigation Team"
4.desc: When Sunna uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, all squad members deal <color=#FFFFFF>18%</color> increased DMG for 60s.
4.desc2:
From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.

5.name: "Galaxy Tramway"
5.desc2:
The stars were strung across the night like gas lamps lit at dusk.
She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.
The passengers were all adorable little creatures like cats, dogs, and bunnies, and the conductor was fluent in the languages of deep-sea fish and owls.
Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

6.name: "Hollow Big Bang"
6.desc:
When Sunna uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state for 8s.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, Sunna can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, its DMG being calculated using <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent rules. If <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered while Sunna has a <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> is immediately consumed, and <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
6.desc2:
"Why did you choose to step onto the stage?"
Was it for the fans? For the glory under the spotlight? Or for that version of yourself who stayed in the corner, watching others play, too afraid to step forward?
Maybe it was all of those. Or maybe it was none of them.
All the girl knew was that the moment she gripped the microphone, her heartbeat would slow, and the world around her would fall quiet... until the drums kicked in, and the music rippled across the stage. In that split second, music's gentle light illuminated the time they all shared together.
It felt as if they were angels, with wings capable of carrying everyone away from "the here and now."

name: Aria
description:
Aria is the lead vocalist and center of the Angels of Delusion. Bright and full of energy, she always shines on stage, bringing warmth and strength to all Delulus.
She has a near-perfect voice, even though she was never professionally trained. At first, Aria only sang because she loved her idol, the retired songstress Cersea, copying her performances and singing along, until she realized she had a gift for song of her own.
Though Aria's vocal skills are undeniably professional, she lacks a solid foundation in dance. Even with dedicated practice, she can still get flustered when faced with more complex moves. Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.

profile.impression_f: An idol performing on stage with a virtual avatar... Does that count as being a virtual idol?
profile.impression_m: Uh... That doesn't feel quite right, Belle... but I honestly don't know how to refute it...

Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.
trust_lv.3:
Unlike her bright, glamorous stage persona, Aria's true form is an A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct, built for combat. However, as she took part in more combat operations, she slowly grew to hate the feeling of "bringing pain to others."
After being abandoned in a Hollow alongside others of the same model, she was awakened once more by Cersea's singing. In Eridu, she saw how such a voice could spark hope in people and draw them into "delusions," and it was then that the desire to sing began to take root within her. By chance, she once served as Cersea's "voice double," but after Cersea retired, she returned to normal life. It was only after being invited by Nangong and Sunna to join the Angels of Delusion that Aria truly stepped onto the stage, meeting the Delulus who loved her voice face-to-face.
Perhaps shaped by her past experiences, Aria feels deeply insecure about her identity as a construct. When she switches to her construct form, she becomes shy and timid, speaking slowly and hesitantly. But the moment she activates her energetic idol projection, she instantly returns to her bright, outgoing, high-energy self, shining like a little sun on her teammates and the Delulus in the audience.

3115010.name: Aria: Energetic Idol
3115010.desc: A touch of pink and white, a hint of lights and sound, plus countless days and nights devoted to singing — all of it comes together as a boundless delusion on stage.

3115011.name: Aria: Discordant Note
3115011.desc:
Aria's performance outfit for special shows, worn only a handful of times.
A pure-white "angel" clad in "demonic" wings. Take a deep breath, get ready... once the spotlight comes on, it's the Angels of Delusion's time to rebel.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sweet Melody
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> is generated on the field after the attack ends.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If there is <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>, with each absorbed <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>'s <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup</color> by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweet Melody</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if there are at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and quickly activate a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>. After a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if there are at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby, a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> can also be quickly activated by pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> within a short window, consuming 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.

descriptions.desc:

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked
descriptions.desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice
EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion
Chain Attack: Dream Collab
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> are generated on the field on skill activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: 100% Energy
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Releases all her power, entering <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Upon entering <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, Aria gains 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will first cancel any existing instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>.
While Aria is charging, if she has <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color>, stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> are consumed first to charge. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, if Aria already has <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color>, all remaining stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> are first converted into <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and generated on the field. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> is converted into 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color> lasts for up to 15s. During <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> 3rd attack is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, if Aria has <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color>, all remaining stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> are converted into <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and generated on the field. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> is converted into 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Shatter Fantasy
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweet Melody</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Clutch Save
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Encore Song
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful series of slashes on the target, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Energetic Sound Waves
1.desc: When Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup RES</color>. Additionally, when Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
1.desc2:
"You see them? Everyone out there is waiting for us. So when the lights come up, we have to be full of energy. That's what it means to be an idol."
—A few whispered words before going on stage.

2.name: Fantastical Beat
2.desc: When Aria attacks or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, attacks and <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.
2.desc2: "We don't have to sing it yet. Just close our eyes, feel it, and accept it. Then, on stage, through our performance, we'll make the whole audience fall in love with it."

3.name: Delulu
3.desc2: "Whether it's a dream or just a delusion, we just need to keep running toward a better version of ourselves. Everyone is worthy of being appreciated, and every effort will be remembered by someone."

4.name: Mechanical Angel
4.desc: When Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
4.desc2:
My wings are moonlight forged from tempered steel,
with lines of code, each vibration made real.
Gears bite into the rhythm of destiny,
while silent electricity roars through me.

5.name: Tears in the Rain
5.desc2: I once saw a city swallowed by the Hollows, its order reshaped by Ether. Everything beautiful was consumed by darkness, sinking into the long river of time... like tears fading in the rain.

6.name: Construct's Dream
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Aria enters <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, she will not exit it, and <color=#FFFFFF>enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> and her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> deal 40% increased <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color>. This effect can occur once every 6s. When gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> effect, if already at 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color>, any excess <color=#FFFFFF>All-Out Cheering</color> is converted into 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and generated on the field.
6.desc2:
Do you still remember that night in September, when love was born?
Do you still remember the dancing on the stage, in those days when we fell into delusions?

name: Nangong Yu
description:
Nangong Yu, the captain and choreographer of the idol group the "Angels of Delusion," is a rare prodigy blessed with exceptional Ether aptitude, a sharp business acumen, and outstanding idol talent.

Though she always presents herself with a laid-back air — teasing her teammates and joking around — she consistently receives the fewest negative reviews in the group. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed," she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Nangong possesses a rare gift for making the difficult look effortless — whether it's dancing, rapping, making investments, or reading people. That gift once served as the mask that allowed her to easily play the role of "captain," yet it also kept her isolated from her true desires.

Yet whether it started as responsibility toward a close friend or later turned into an irreplaceable love for the stage, beneath the stage lights and the audience's gaze she has already forged those borrowed sparks into a light of her own.

profile.impression_f: Nangong can do anything effortlessly and flawlessly. If only Wise had that kind of talent, things would be so much easier for me, too. I'm kidding, Wise is great~
profile.impression_m: I'm truly to blame for not being able to back you up, Belle... I'll have to learn more from Nangong!

"Talent" is the halo that lets Nangong move through everything with ease, but it once also served as the fog that dulled her sense of her true feelings. She's skilled at evaluating and planning for everything, yet when it comes to the seemingly intangible concept of "dreams," she can't put a price on it.

When the Angels of Delusion formed, Nangong Yu found herself dealing with a stingy agency that even charged its trainees for training. For the first time, she felt that her talent for "always spotting a business opportunity" had failed her. She could calculate the optimal choreography and predict which stocks would rise, yet she couldn't figure out how to keep this fragile group, built around Sunna's dream, alive. When their last savings ran dry and their only lead vocalist was about to quit under financial pressure, a dangerous "opportunity" appeared: use their unregistered Ether aptitude to enter a Hollow and carry out a high-paying "material recovery" job.

It wasn't a dance studio — it was a real fight for survival. The makeshift weapon in her hand felt worlds heavier than any stage prop. And the rapid, frightened breaths Sunna took beside her set her nerves on edge far more than the roar of any crowd. In the end, they were lucky enough to complete the commission and bring back payment that could keep the group afloat. But when they stumbled back into the safe zone and looked at the dust-covered reward in their hands, what Nangong felt wasn't joy.

She realized that what she was willing to risk her life and endure fear for was no longer the abstract duty of "helping a friend achieve her dream." It was the melody Sunna had written in that shabby rehearsal room, and the songs Aria had sung, the voices, and the stage that would one day belong to them. That longing itself had gained a weight no investment return could ever measure. From that day forward, she continued to calculate how to guard this "bargain dream" — one she had pulled into motion with her own hands and could no longer abandon — at the smallest possible cost.

3115110.name: Nangong Yu: Dreamy Dancer
3115110.desc:
Dreams are both cheap and expensive, always just out of reach. The people on the ground call them stars.
So the angel walks among the stars and lifts a sliver of fantasy from the endless galaxy... the very first rainbow light that shone upon her.

3115111.name: Nangong Yu: Rhapsody's Muse
3115111.desc:
Dancing within disordered rhythms, spinning across a stage of wild fantasia.
The boundary between angel and demon tilts with the lights, dissolving within her reflection.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Shooting Star Step
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a charged attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>.
After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, if enough <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> are available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> do not interrupt the combo count of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Natural Dancer
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Spinning Meteor
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Asteroid Waltz
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: The Weight of Love
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: The Weight of Love
EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love
Chain Attack: Comet Gravity
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Meteor Shower
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch multiple attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> again, the current <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Emergency Save
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Perfected Choreography
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Improvised Performance
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Prodigious Idol
Additional Ability: Angel Captain
desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>11%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Emergency Save</color> hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> is consumed to trigger the special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will also be consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color> hits an enemy, the enemy suffers <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color>. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> recovers from Stun, the <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> effect ends.
