1.name: Lazy Spotlight
1.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
1.desc2: Dreams are such troublesome and expensive things. When the spotlight shines on her, it just feels a little warm, that's all. Honestly, watching Sunna blush from being teased, seeing Aria short-circuit from nerves, or discovering our next lucky break might be far more entertaining to her.

2.name: Painless Tears
2.desc: Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>'s additional <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio increase from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Prodigious Idol</color> increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Angel Captain</color> increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.
2.desc2: Tears are a valuable stage prop, but unfortunately, she's always been short on stock. Luckily, her acting skills as an idol are good enough to make them fall right on cue when needed... whether it's to comfort a real crybaby, or win a little sympathy from the audience.

3.name: Chips on the Scales
3.desc2: Choreography can be arranged, stage positions can be planned, and even popularity and the future seem like things money can sort out. Watching the numbers bounce around in the account feels like a reassuring little game... until a problem shows up with no price tag attached. Fiddling with the stack of "chips" she's best at using makes the scale of "it's just business" start to wobble.

4.name: Accomplice's Dance Step
4.desc: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The Anomaly Buildup of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.
4.desc2: I've got a habit of giving Sunna the most dazzling position on stage, and leaving Aria the high note that cuts through the night sky. My "dream" was borrowed from them, but the resolve to protect what I borrowed belongs entirely to me.

5.name: Center Stage
5.desc2: The Yearlight lanterns drift up into the sky, and the stage curtain finally opens. The stage, the lights, their faces... everything has never been this clear. Turns out I've been standing in the center of the spotlight all along. I was never just watching from the sidelines.

6.name: An Angel's Delusion
6.desc: Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze. When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>. When hit by the heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, they gain 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>. When hit by the heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color>, they gain 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> stacks are cleared. When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> is cleared, if the enemy is under an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>800%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>400%</color>/<color=#FF5521>1,000%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>70%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>100%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>40%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> cannot stack with <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
6.desc2: Cameras, cheering crowds, glow sticks... that distant warmth turns into blazing fire. The dream I borrowed from others has already fused with my flesh and blood. From here on, this intoxicating "Delusion" will be defined by Captain Nangong.

name: Cissia
description:
Cissia, a case specialist serving under the New Eridu Public Security Commissioner, is currently campaigning to become the new second-floor roommate at Random Play.

More than the danger of the mission itself, what she fears most is a call from her superior. The professionalism she shows in her actions is far more dependable than how she looks or the way she talks. Relying only on instinct and her senses, she can still make the right call.

She may claim to be a selfish, instinct-driven "bad guy," but the choices she makes often carry a faint glimmer of humanity beyond personal gain. She scoffs at order and justice, yet can become the sharpest blade in the hunt for the worst criminals.

But whether it's the lies she tells to protect herself, the fangs she shows when she bites back, or that wild philosophy of "survive and profit," Cissia has turned them all into a shield to protect the few things she still has. No matter what past or shackles she carries, she has already decided to make her stand here.

profile.impression_f: There isn't a single snack that can get past Cissia's eyes and nose! How in the world can she smell potato chips through the packaging?
profile.impression_m: Ever since Cissia started coming over on the regular, some things have never gone missing again... like those old videotapes that were always impossible to find. And some things have never been seen again either... like the leftover cheesecake in the fridge.

trust_lv.3:
"Instinct" is the foundation Cissia relies on to survive, yet it has also become the force pulling her deeper into the vortex. She places too much trust in the signals she reads from scent, tracks, and subtle muscle movements, yet has never learned to spot the pitfalls buried in paperwork and systems of authority.

Before her arrest, the last "legitimate" job Cissia took was transporting a batch of confidential supplies. The client offered generous pay and a simple route — an easy task for someone who knew the Outer Ring's back alleys like the back of her hand. As usual, her animal-like vigilance helped her slip through a few narrow patrol windows. What she didn't realize was that every evasive move was being logged as evidence of "suspicious behavior" and "counter-surveillance ability." When the explosion that swallowed everything erupted, she had already slipped into an abandoned pipe seconds earlier after sensing an unusual surge of heat. It saved her life — and cemented her identity as the "only surviving, highly suspicious arson suspect."

In Public Security's files, her instincts and abilities were twisted into proof of a carefully planned crime. The interrogation wasn't meant to uncover the truth, but to carry out a cold procedure: blinding lights to break her tolerance for brightness, endless questioning to strip away her sense of time, and finally, when her body and mind were on the verge of collapse, a confession was pushed in front of her.

Amid countless misfortunes, fortune finally showed her a trace of favor. Commissioner Severian uncovered the glaring flaws in Cissia's interrogation records. Recognizing her remarkable talent and fundamentally good nature, Severian personally recruited her as a "case specialist." From that moment on, the collar and handcuffs were no longer simple shackles. They marked a dangerous line between her and the system of order she neither understood nor trusted — one she had learned to use to her advantage.

3115210.name: Cissia: Snake & Mouse Game
3115210.desc:
There are two kinds of people in this world, venomous snakes and mice! As for who is what...
Lady Cissia says: Those stronger than me are snakes, and those weaker than me are mice!

Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.desc:
With <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> and drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> gained, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, all <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Corrode Bone
descriptions.desc:
Deal <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Slither
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Bite Mark
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Bite Back
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Bared Fangs
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite
descriptions.desc:
With enough energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tongue Flick</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Gang Operation
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Ophidiophobia
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color> a second time will first deactivate the active <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Alarm System
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Bared Fangs</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Extra Prison Rations
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Partners in Crime
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Fatal Concoction
Additional Ability: Festering Venom
desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> every 5s while in combat to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
With <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, all squad memebrs' <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> ignores <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of enemy DEF. If initial Energy Regen is higher than 1.4, for every additional 0.12 above that threshold, an additional <color=#2BAD00>0.52%</color> of the enemy's DEF is ignored, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>12.88%</color> of enemy DEF. This effect lasts until 30s after <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is depleted.
<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> deals additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>227%</color> of ATK.
When there are 1/2 <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color> characters in the squad, the Daze dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> increases by 40%/60%.
When gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, every 1 excess point of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> once.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character or shares the same attribute:
While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 40%, with Cissia gaining an additional 10%. The effect lasts until 30s after <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is depleted.

1.name: Traveler and Prey
1.desc: The <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive</color> increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> DMG ignores 10% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
1.desc2:
Scents, footsteps, the way someone's eyes shift... those are the "clues" that let me sort hunters from prey. I vanish before I'm hunted. I lower my head before I hunt. That's how I stay alive.
"Home"? That's just something out of a storybook. The endless wild is my hunting cabin.

2.name: Hunger and Hard Truths
2.desc: After a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Gang Operation</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Ophidiophobia</color> hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color> deals 35% increased DMG.
2.desc2: If I can eat my fill there, it's a good place. If someone gives me food, they're a good person. That's the easiest and most dependable rule in the world. And also, omelet with rice is divine. Even that last leftover bit on the spoon.

3.name: Chains and a Warm Nest
3.desc2: Justice? Order? That kind of righteous, aboveboard stuff makes me shaky. What I know are the rules of the shadows — betrayal, lies, bowing low if it keeps me breathing. I don't mind being used as a tool, as long as the pay is a full meal and a warm corner to curl up in.

4.name: A Rogue's Resolve
4.desc: When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Decidedness</color>, stacking up to 3 times. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>, consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Decidedness</color>. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> that does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> does not cause Daze.
4.desc2: The collar around my neck is cold. The handcuffs are heavy. They remind me of the sins I can't wash away. But compared to those invisible rules and icy stares, this kind of restraint with a clear price tag actually puts me at ease... at least I know what it costs. And once I'm back in that little den with a couch and snacks, even the cold metal seems warm.

5.name: False Evidence and Fangs
5.desc2: Memories scorched by blinding light, crimes spelled out in black and white... those "marks" were once all that defined me. But things are different now. I've learned to read, and I've learned to recognize the smell of a lie. When that familiar scent of a scheme creeps in again, I won't just walk into the cage like an idiot. This time, I'll be the one leaving "marks" — with my teeth, and I won't hold back.

6.name: Home and Sixth Street
6.desc: Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> is triggered, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bone-Deep Corrosion</color>. When attacks from any squad member, other than <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>, hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bone-Deep Corrosion</color> to trigger 1 special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>. This instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bone-Deep Corrosion</color> can be consumed every 3s.
6.desc2:
Once there's something I want to hold onto more than just "staying alive," I really do turn stupid. If fate ever decides I have to die, that big, soft couch of yours better not have anyone else lying on it.

"Don't you dare forget me... or I'll bite you to death."

strategy: Provides buffs to boost CRIT DMG and ignore a portion of enemy DEF
Deals sustained DMG off-field and inflicts additional Daze

name: Starlight - Billy

3115310.name: Starlight - Billy: Starlight Armaments
3115310.desc: Those who always believe in hope will, in the end, become someone else's hope.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Knight's Technique
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During the 4th hit, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, reducing HP consumption by 50%.
Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight
descriptions.desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Charges forward on the motorcycle, then fires a laser beam, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Close Call!
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Through the Galaxy
descriptions.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Drifts with the motorcycle, enabling <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodges</color> for a brief duration.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is successfully triggered, it immediately chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin</color>.
During this skill, continue dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to continue drifting.
During this skill, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> will continue, and upon reaching the maximum duration, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
If the skill ends early, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Run Wild</color>.
Character is briefly invulnerable and Anti-Interrupt Level increases during this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Performs a quick forward slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Duel King
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If this skill is triggered via a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin
descriptions.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Through the Galaxy</color>, trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Spins with the bike to deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to surrounding enemies.
After using this skill, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Drive Suppression
descriptions.desc:
When HP is above 25%, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Run Wild
descriptions.desc:
Triggers automatically when <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Through the Galaxy</color> is interrupted:
Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be chained into <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie
descriptions.desc:
Triggers automatically when <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
On hit, restores an additional 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Run Wild</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels
descriptions.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork
descriptions.desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color> and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gains 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve
Additional Ability: Blazing Starlight
desc:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume HP and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color> when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color> regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, activating <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger</color>, or triggering a block restores additional <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>. Triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> by any means restores 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color> is greater than or equal to 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>.
Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color> restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color> activated through a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> restores HP. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color> restores HP.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color> by 20%.

1.name: Heroic Entrance
1.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Knight's Resolve</color> restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color> for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
1.desc2:
There are just as many bad guys in New Eridu as in a visual FX show, but there aren't many real heroes.
"I might be good at shouting heroic lines, but I can't really call myself a hero yet..."
"But I'll follow their example and stand up front to protect everyone!"

2.name: Wasteland Automaton
2.desc: Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> by 50%. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color>, or hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> grants the <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> consumes this effect to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> can be held.
2.desc2:
There's no shortage of sharpshooters in the Outer Ring, but keeping perfect aim on a speeding bike is what defines a real ace.
"Ballistic calculations and mechanical fingers? Of course they help..."
"But the real reason I'm dead-on every time is because... the Starlight chose me!"

3.name: Knight's Chivalry
3.desc2:
What does it really mean to be a Starlight Knight? Never backing down and standing up for the weak? Sacrifice, justice, compassion, honor?
"Do what is right..."
"And don't compromise on what's not cool!"
"That's why I'll never abandon my companions!"

4.name: Flames of Justice
4.desc: While in combat, each use of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.
4.desc2:
Ideals are born to uphold justice, yet they're destined to be abandoned.
"You're saying those shows are just for kids...?"
"The most courageous dreams are the ones only kids dare to believe in, right?"
"Then I, Starlight - Billy, will protect those ridiculed dreams!"

5.name: Radiant Armaments
5.desc2:
You need a dazzling outfit to look like a real hero... it makes the whole thing pretty inconvenient.
"I'm not strong because of larger-caliber weapons or higher-power components!"
"My true weapon... is the endless starlight!"

6.name: Starlight Knight
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>'s Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Brilliant Starlight</color>, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, consumes up to 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Brilliant Starlight</color>, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
6.desc2:
Those who always believe in hope will, in the end, become someone else's hope.
This is the story of the Starlight Knights, the story of Billy Kid.
"Starlight Knight — Transformation!"

strategy: Bike mode continuously consumes HP to gain bonus DMG
Packs various ways to restore HP

name: Promeia
description:
Promeia, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, is primarily responsible for carrying out "executions."

Unlike the other Judges in Krampus, each with their own strong personalities, Promeia feels more like an iceberg lurking beneath the surface. Quiet and reserved, she seems to have no personal interests or hobbies.

For the majority within the TOPS Alliance, avoiding any involvement with her is a given. If their misdeeds are exposed and they end up under Krampus scrutiny, the first thing those anxious rulebreakers pray for is that Promeia won't be handling their case.

There's a rumor that circulates quietly within the company, but no one dares talk about it openly. Before joining the Krampus Compliance Authority, Promeia came from the infamous Sweepers, an Outer Ring group that served Calydon and specialized in eliminating "unstable elements."

profile.impression_f: She doesn't say much, but Promeia gets her point across with surprising clarity... What a remarkable skill!
profile.impression_m: If you're ever struggling to make a choice, feel free to come to us! Whether it's as your role as a Krampus Judge, or simply as a friend~

trust_lv.3:
Promeia received her handcuffs upon joining Krampus, something she personally insisted on as her only condition. Krampus didn't confiscate the key, but beyond duty to her mission, she almost never chooses to take them off. To her, they represent both restraint and judgment.

The rumors are true.
Back when Promeia was a Sweeper, her primary duty was dealing with so-called "Ethereals" afflicted with irreversible corruption, ending both their lives and their suffering. She once believed it was all for some greater cause, for the land beneath her feet. Trembling, she accepted that heavy fate.
Until the truth came to light.
That arrogant, razor-sharp killer died. What remained was nothing more than a prisoner, burdened by fate and guilt.

3115410.name: Promeia: Shrouded in Frost
3115410.desc: Darkness is a weapon that fits perfectly in my hand. As an executioner, I'm already at home in the night, but carrying heavy shackles, it's easy to lose my way.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Whirling Blade
descriptions.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.

descriptions.name: Bound Absolution
descriptions.desc:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.

param.name: Cloak Slash DMG Per Second Multiplier

descriptions.name: Dodge: Veiled Step
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Grim Reap
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Soaring Bat
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Execution - Cold Flash
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
descriptions.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>.
Upon use, Promeia gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
descriptions.desc:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death</color>:
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, and with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 40 Energy and activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost
descriptions.desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost
descriptions.desc:
After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
descriptions.desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> and after performing the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
After using this skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special>, or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment
descriptions.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement
descriptions.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Ambushing Strike
descriptions.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Injunction
descriptions.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Intercepting Strike
descriptions.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1541004.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death

1541005.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
1541005.desc: Automatically activates when receiving an attack shortly upon using EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death

1541006.name: Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost
1541006.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> (In Bound Absolution state with Absolute Order)

1541007.name: Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost
1541007.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> (After triggering EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow)

1541008.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
1541008.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> (Hold after the downward attack while having sufficient Trial by Cold)

name: Core Passive: Thief of Flames
Additional Ability: Vessel of Ice
desc:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, when the enemy is inflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, or when Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Promeia gains an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> reaches at least 50, 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> is consumed and converted into 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, up to a maximum of 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
When the finishing move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing <color=#2BAD00>330%</color> Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color> grants <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> and immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> can be held.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Promeia's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on a target with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color> lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Promeia gains an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> reaches at least 50, 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> is consumed and converted into 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, up to a maximum of 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
When the finishing move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing <color=#2BAD00>585%</color> Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. With <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> and immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> can be held.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Promeia's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on a target with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color> lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

1.name: Innocent Idealism
1.desc: When Promeia uses <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, she gains an additional effect: if <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>. This effect can trigger once after using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.
1.desc2:
This is a chaotic, lawless land.
Roaring engines and swirling dust, steel clashing with flesh. Conflict and violence play out day and night.
An innocent child grips an equally innocent weapon, wandering the same lost red earth.
"Would you be willing to do your part for the peace here?"

2.name: Faltering Conviction
2.desc: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> increases by 120%.
2.desc2:
She became an exceptional Sweeper — swift, precise, and silent. Her targets were clear and countless: Ethereals, those infected with irreversible Corruption, those fated to turn into Ethereals... every kill marked by bloodshed and the echoes of their cries.
But... is it right?
"This is a Sweeper's duty!" "Just think of it as... for the greater good, got it?" "Those people were going to die anyway." ...
"It's a necessary sacrifice."

3.name: Cruel Moonlight
3.desc2:
The truth is often carved out from an unremarkable accident.
"You think the Sweepers could get rich just by dealing with worthless Ethereals?"
"Gang wars are a guaranteed profit. If you're afraid of getting your hands dirty, the 'Black Wolf' is more than eager..."
Night fell soon after, earlier than anyone expected.
The Sweepers, Calydon, the gangs with names and those without... in this chaotic age, all seemed to vanish into the endless dark.

4.name: Ruthless Accusation
4.desc: When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she restores 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
4.desc2:
An invitation arrived, summoning a moth to its judgment.
The right to choose, light, justice, and everything that made her "Promeia."
She put on the handcuffs and chose exile for herself.
"This is my final choice."

5.name: The Dying Moth
5.desc2:
She buried herself in her work.
Investigations, interrogations, judgments... an endless list.
Her colleagues watched her with concern.
"How long are you going to keep this up...?"
"Until every last sin is atoned for... or until death takes me."

6.name: To Be Continued
6.desc: When Promeia consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it triggers an additional special <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s. In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.
6.desc2:
The end didn't arrive as expected, and the night wasn't as dark as imagined.
Colleagues, old acquaintances, late-night lights, and new friends...
The poor moth still couldn't shake off these heavy gifts, and that long-awaited ending now felt even further away.
But maybe... such a fate isn't so bad.

3115510.desc: The dying heat haze extinguished within the valley will one day be reborn from the sea. The beast that trampled fate beneath its feet will become the chariot that clears the path ahead.

1.name: Shadows of Twilight Past
1.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 1,000 <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. CRIT Rate increases by 8%.
1.desc2:
The dark night is a tide of shadow, drowning the fields of a fallen civilization.
Deluded gods forge a blazing golden spear, seeking to pierce the throat of the abyss.

2.name: Blazing Cavalry
2.desc: Using Ultimate: Triumphant Return grants 1,500 <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s. Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.
2.desc2:
All forgotten stories and muffled cries sink into the arid sea behind a pair of eyes,
awaiting a chariot ablaze with searing flames to roll across the lightless surface of the abyss.

3.name: Chains of Fate
3.desc2:
The chariot shines in splendor, the scorched earth stretches without end.
Yet within the body of an innocent child grows a tyrant destined to consume all life.

4.name: Balefire Horizon
4.desc: When Pyrois triggers a Perfect Block with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo</color>, immediately gain shield equal to 8% of Max HP, lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Pyrois deals 10% extra Daze while shielded.
4.desc2:
Perhaps the beacon of first light can only be reached by passing through the darkest night. Perhaps every hero must walk a road of thorns.
So the forsaken child wanders in self-imposed exile, until the cursed fire burns away the final remains of their mortal shell.

5.name: Youthful Guardian
5.desc2:
The tyrant's crown is remade as a bridle, with silver-white iron wardens and gallant horses.
They guard the child who burns forever, crossing beyond the digital prison and the deceptions of the night.

6.name: Morning Star at Dawn
6.desc: Mindscape Effect Hidden
6.desc2:
Dusk bleeds crimson, dawn soft as ever.
The morning star has risen above the horizon, wiping away the tears of childhood.
Its soft sigh lingers like the closing rhyme of a poem.
The long night is but a prelude to sunrise.

name: Velina
description:
Velina, the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department, oversees cooperation and diplomacy between Roscaelifer and New Eridu.

As a descendant of the prestigious Airgid family, Velina inherited a strict and meticulous upbringing. Renowned for her nearly flawless efficiency and exceptional ability to keep any situation under control, she is the dependable adult whom Chief Technician Norma describes as someone capable of "handling meetings, paperwork, and troublesome people."

She is sharp and efficient in her work, meticulous, and always gentle and composed when dealing with others. Beneath her elegant, effortless smile lies an intensity that is impossible to ignore. No matter how troublesome the diplomatic affair or absurd the disaster may be, Velina can resolve it with ease. However, the price of seeking her help is not always one the requester can afford.

Velina has a particular fondness for all kinds of black tea and often invites friends to tea parties during her spare time.

Please note: Any tea party invitation sent by Velina in her capacity as Administrative Director should never be taken lightly. They are rarely mere leisure. More often, they serve as the perfect setting for her to negotiate situations and quietly steer events toward her desired outcome.

profile.impression_f: Velina deals with all kinds of people every day, yet she still can't get used to Nitro-Fuel... That's really surprising!
profile.impression_m: Belle... Even if you've figured out her weakness, don't go getting any ideas... Taking her back to the External Strategy Department that night caused a huge scene.

trust_lv.3:
As the governing body of the Marcel Group, the External Strategy Department is responsible for handling Bangboo retirement approvals. Because of this, Velina is known among Bangboo citizens as the legendary "Death Witch" — the tea party host whose very presence sends chills through their circuits.

In reality, though, Velina is none other than the "Chief Angel" famed throughout Bangboo society. Yet she has no issue with her infamy. The title of witch makes many Bangboo-related matters easier to handle, and rather than being worshipped as an angel, she is more comfortable acting as their quiet protector.

Velina also seems unexpectedly awkward with certain aspects of daily life, particularly when it comes to raising plants or animals. She's even earned the title of "Serial Plant Killer."

Suggestion: Perhaps this could serve as an effective way to grow closer to her.

3115610.name: Velina: Elegant Silver Cascade
3115610.desc: Some busybodies claim the Administrative Director rejected the External Strategy Department's official uniform to show off her prestigious upbringing, but Velina has always had little interest in lavish fashion. Rather than the elaborate glamour of ceremonial wear, she favors simple clothing: sharp, proper, and suited to dealing with never-ending administrative work.

3115611.name: Velina: Shade of Leisure
3115611.desc: Outside of work, Velina occasionally invites close friends to afternoon tea parties. During such moments, she changes into relatively casual attire to enjoy her free time... though to the Bangboo, it's merely the Grim Reaper in a different terrifying disguise.

1.name: Orderly Elegance
1.desc2:
Every word and gesture is placed precisely where it belongs.
Before the other party even realizes it, they willingly accept the boundaries, rhythm, and outcome she has arranged—
"Elegance is simply the most natural expression of order in motion."

2.name: Saturation Project
2.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she can also gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette</color> are further increased by 15%.
2.desc2:
She anticipates every possibility, accounts for every variable, and makes backup plans for things going wrong.
She never relies on chance. Every ending is calculated.
Even if the situation veers off course for a moment, it only leads onto another path she has already prepared for.
"Sigh, so it's come to this... Good thing I'm not entirely unprepared."

3.name: Conquest by Etiquette
3.desc2:
No need to force submission through strength, nor rely on emotion or intimidation.
A graceful response and a carefully measured compromise are enough...
Before anyone realizes it, the situation has already been steered toward destined conquest.
"Is etiquette simply violence in disguise?"
"Or is etiquette the more refined form of violence?"

4.name: Tea Party Tribunal
4.desc: When Velina uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, her ATK increases by 15% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
4.desc2:
In the midst of laughter and conversation, the scales have already tipped.
The tea has yet to go cold, yet the verdict is already sold.
"If something's bothering me, I'll simply deal with it and move on. And if someone's bothering me, heh..."

5.name: Death Witch
5.desc2:
"Her footsteps herald judgment!"
"Her invitation is your funeral!"
The silver-haired witch sits calmly beneath the theater of the Bangboo Kingdom, listening to the tiny performers hurl accusations at her with absolute conviction. She gently waves her ornate fan, smiling without a word.

6.name: Chief Angel
6.desc: When Velina consumes 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to increase the DMG Multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s. When Velina hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, the <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly Buildup</color> she inflicts increases by 20%. When Velina inflicts <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> on an enemy already affected by <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, the new <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>'s DMG increases based on the remaining duration of the previous. Each remaining second increases the DMG by 2.5%, up to a maximum increase of 40%.
6.desc2: "There is no need to ask an angel's name. She hides within rumors, behind reprimands, and within the fearful letters requesting aid you deliver with shaking hands."

name: Norma
description:
Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department and a central figure within Marcel Group's technological center. No matter how long or complicated her titles may sound, the young Miss Norma is without question a titan in the field of Bangboo technology. Even Lady Sunbringer herself may not understand every gear and chip inside a Bangboo body better than Norma does.

She fits every stereotype people have about genius scientists: her engineering skills are exceptional, while her people skills are inversely proportional. She takes Velina's "Etiquette Manual" seriously, and is equally serious about never following it.

A firm believer in performance above all, she was once feared by Bangboo due to her radical Bangboo modification techniques and somewhat less-than-Bangboo-centered approach, earning a reputation as a terrifying scientist who would stop at nothing for her research. ...The safety engineers at the External Strategy Department lab may share a similar view.

It's less that the title of "Chief Technician" crowned Norma in the field of Bangboo technology, and more that Norma herself represents the pinnacle of the Marcel Group's technological achievements.

profile.impression_f: Now if the Bangboo at home ever come down with some strange malfunction, we'll know where to find a "doctor"~!
profile.impression_m: I think I finally understand how pets feel when they don't want to go to the vet.

trust_lv.3:
She has absolute confidence in her own technology and is always driven by a curiosity to pursue new things and push boundaries. As for the methods she uses to satisfy that curiosity, depending on one's perspective, they could be described as either "innocent" or "terrifying."

She possesses sharp insight, capable of noticing connections between things that most people would never understand, and her methods of solving problems are often wildly unconventional.

Although feared by Bangboo, she still somehow manages to rope many of them into participating in her experiments. The key is her surprisingly impressive social skills with Bangboo and preschool-aged children alike, though those skills only seem effective on the innocent and inexperienced.

Her methods often leave both people and Bangboo who do not understand her intentions feeling uneasy, yet her deep dedication to Bangboo technology stems not only from scientific curiosity but also from the burden of carrying on Lady Sunbringer's technological legacy.

1.name: Visionary Extremism
1.desc2:
Advance! By any means necessary!
Too many things are chasing us in this dying world: the pitch-black frontier, our fleeting lifespan.
Human life and civilization are more fragile than a Bangboo's logic core.
The only way to stay ahead of destruction is to keep moving forward, by any means necessary.
"Besides, the first to witness a new horizon always sees the most beautiful view, don't they?"

2.name: Axiom of Universal Unity
2.desc: The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> in Norma's <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers</color> is increased to 6%. When Norma uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hat Trick</color> while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
2.desc2:
The world of physicists is constantly overturned by new theories. The order ordinary people rely on is just as often shattered by unexpected events and conflict.
The ties that bind all things are always mysterious, both incredibly intimate and incredibly fragile, impossible to fully comprehend.
"Bring Bangboo and Roscaelifer to greater heights? You mean 'the byproduct of chasing curiosity,' right?"

3.name: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
3.desc2:
It's another calm, peaceful day in Roscaelifer, with clear skies and a gentle breeze.
But for the Bangboo, there may still be one ultimate supervillain...
"Why is it that the smartest genius in every kids' cartoon always ends up becoming the bad guy...?"
"Seriously, what's so great about those crazy scientists whose budget and hairline are both hanging on by a thread?"

4.name: Bangboo Superiority Theory
4.desc: When Norma consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.
4.desc2:
Without a doubt, Bangboo are the most loyal companions humanity has had in the past century, the most efficient tools, and perhaps even... the most powerful weapons.
Like any child yet to be taught or any blade yet to find a worthy owner, a Bangboo can serve anyone, whether it's the righteous Phaethon or the most ruthless villain.
"First of all, I'm a pacifist who happens to love Bangboo."
"Second, part of my job is making sure the sharpest sword stays in our hands."

5.name: En-Nah Big Bang
5.desc2:
According to archived External Strategy Department records, a project led by the young researcher Norma rapidly pushed the performance limits of mass-produced Bangboo to new heights.
Before being promoted to Chief Technician of the ESD, Norma's most important assignment was proving that she wouldn't one day launch Booastrum into orbit.
"Higher! Faster! Stronger!"
"The only things limiting imagination are courage and the R&D budget!"

6.name: The Primary Cause of Genius
6.desc2: Every great creation begins with curiosity and a happy accident. Perhaps the birth of the very first Bangboo soul was nothing more than Lady Sunbringer's fascination with the mysteries of life.

1.name: A long, long time ago,
1.desc: When the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> is triggered, enter or refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunstance]</color> and gain one opportunity to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color>; excess <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> opportunities cause the next <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> to deal an extra <color=#FFFFFF>150%</color> DMG; Sigrid's own ATK increases by <color=#FFFFFF>22%</color>.
1.desc2:
Long, long ago, the great Sunbringer scooped up the very first handful of earth on the sky islands…
Hold on, hold on — the kids have heard the story of Lady Sunbringer building the first island of Roscaelifer so many times their ears have grown calluses.
What we're here to talk about today is the story of the warrior who stood at Lady Sunbringer's side — clad in silver-white armor as radiant as a moonlit night, just like a Knight of old from a fairy tale…

2.name: Act One of the Legendary
2.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color> deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> that ignores <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color> of the target's <color=#FFFFFF>DEF</color>; the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> effect is extended by 2s;
2.desc2:
She was Roscaelifer's first Soldier, its first spear — standing at the first line of defense against the Hollow, leading the first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands raised the first walls of Roscaelifer.
She was the first blade of Roscaelifer to be broken. Her name was de L'Azur.
Her children, like her legend, burn eternal in the night sky over Roscaelifer.
